html:
Source Module Catalog

Tier A is maintained product implementation; Tier B is operational tooling. Tests, validation scripts, generated output and dependencies are excluded. Subsystem pages expose contracts; import edges are static relationships, not call graphs.

File Language Tier Contract

build.ps1 PowerShell B Forward native Windows packaging arguments and preserve the builder exit status.
build.sh Shell B Launch the native SMTO binary distribution builder on Unix hosts.
build/build Shell B Choose the compiled-distribution driver for the current host.
build/build.ps1 PowerShell B Dispatch the Windows compiled builder with its original exit status.

build/container/release_image.py Python A Bake pinned compiler, documentation dependencies and native prerequisites into the image.
build/container/release_runner.py Python A Clone main, compile and publish; optionally validate with --validate.
build/container/setup-terminal.sh Shell B Supply two legal responses through a bounded disposable installation PTY.
build/container/validate.sh Shell B Qualify extracted binaries using their newly provisioned private Python.

build/fast/driver_fast.py Python A Run the existing source build driver with verified compilation reuse.
build/fast/driver_macos_fast.py Python A Run a selected source checkout's Mac builder with persistent verified inputs.
build/fast/macos_cache.py Python A Native Mac identities, private cache locking and verified preparation receipts.
build/fast/release_runner_fast.py Python A Adapt only the compiler invocation of the unchanged release runner.
build/fast/release_runner_macos_fast.py Python A Opt-in Mac release adapter; publication remains owned by the original runner.
build/launcher/include/platform.hpp C++ A Declare the compiled-image launcher platform boundary: executable/cache discovery, secure paths, build locks, installation confirmation and child supervision. POSIX and Windows implementations supply these operations for the shared launcher.
build/launcher/include/sha256.hpp C++ A Compute SHA-256 digests inside the compiled-image launcher so extracted runtime files can be checked against the embedded manifest without importing Python. A matching digest establishes byte integrity, not publisher identity.
build/launcher/src/main.cpp C++ A Validate and extract the embedded compiled runtime image, report startup progress and enter the selected service through the platform supervisor. File tables, digests and installation acceptance are checked before trusting the prepared runtime.
build/launcher/src/posix.cpp C++ A Implement POSIX path ownership, file modes, cache locking and process supervision for the compiled-image launcher. These checks keep runtime extraction and child execution bound to the selected installation.
build/launcher/src/windows.cpp C++ A Implement Windows path discovery, secured runtime directories, embedded payload access and child-process supervision for the compiled-image launcher.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/init.py Python A Dispatch the compiled Server/Gateway bootstrap using bundled metadata and an explicitly supplied application root. Route read-only queries, maintenance and dependency setup before transferring to the chosen runtime; configure compiled module paths for application and worker subprocesses. The inference-portal role delegates to its own bootstrap. This module selects owners rather than implementing their storage, update or service protocols.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/common.py Python A Supply standard-library setup primitives for pinned inputs, private storage, receipts and shared installation locking. Callers choose trusted metadata, installation intent and staging paths; these helpers validate individual operations without performing the complete dependency workflow. Atomic replacement publishes verified downloads/JSON, but these helpers do not fsync a durable checkpoint.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/gateway_update.py Python A Prepare a candidate without replacing the registered, running gateway instance.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/installer.py Python A Prepare dependency generations for a compiled application while keeping first-party modules in the application image. Resolve a profile identity, reuse a core-ready environment or resume a pending generation, install pinned Python inputs and native prerequisites, then publish a ready/partial receipt after mandatory checks. Custom runtimes receive ABI/core checks without dependency replacement. Failed attempts retain progress and earlier published environments; platform commands and optional feature checks have separate failure policies.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/interaction.py Python A Keep compiled-setup approval and output policy local to the current invocation/context. Bind legal-document versions/hashes through the shared installation owner, remember approval within the session and restore outer state on exit. Command execution supports machine capture, verbose progress and retained quiet failure logs; callers still decide when a command is authorized.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle.py Python A Symmetric, standard-library-only lifecycle commands for compiled applications.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_deferred.py Python A Finish removal of a Windows launcher that cannot be deleted while its invoking process holds it open. Persist the selected manifests under the temporary maintenance runtime, detach a helper to wait for the parent, update registry/removal status and arrange deletion of that temporary runtime afterward. This finalizer is Windows-specific and does not independently recreate the original user confirmation.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_legacy.py Python A Read-only discovery of earlier compiled payloads and dependency receipts.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_privilege.py Python A Retry a caller-selected maintenance manifest through an isolated OS-authorized helper when ordinary permissions are insufficient. Carry the invoking data/cache roots and original identities into bounded removal, snapshot or backup operations, then return structured results. OS authorization and caller plan selection remain separate; partial filesystem work is not rolled back on failure.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_runtime.py Python A Associate a compiled role/instance with its current process, native supervisor and process group. Compare fresh OS identity observations before accepting a running marker or signaling shutdown, and provide recorded runtime environment defaults. Ordinary stops wait for exit; a saved update can request verified escalation of retained service identities. A PID alone never establishes ownership.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_services.py Python A Per-user login services for both compiled roles; never install system daemons.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/lifecycle_store.py Python A Own compiled-installation registry paths, process-compatible locks and recorded resource inventories. Track original directory entries and identities so backup/removal can reject replacements and preserve later additions. The lifecycle orchestrator chooses approved resources and shared references; this module enforces individual path/entry operations, not a whole uninstall transaction or content-based modification policy.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/macos_setup.py Python A Bootstrap pinned MacPorts for a clean native Mac, using the OS authorization UI.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/native_package.py Python A Native package ownership and bounded system service coordination (stdlib only).
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/permissions.py Python A Repair only the requested POSIX installation directory inside an explicitly enabled setup scope. User-owned mode repair needs no elevation; otherwise a terminal prompt and sudo run a fixed isolated helper that checks the original directory identity. Reverify ownership/mode/link boundaries afterward. Contents and parent directories are not recursively repaired, and inactive scopes refuse repairs.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/portal.py Python A Independent portal bootstrap and resumable, portal-only dependency profile.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/portal_service.py Python A Systemd portal installer, using only the authenticated bundled Python stdlib.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/server_update.py Python A Server update recovery runs before importing the application.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/service_cleanup.py Python A Bounded, repeatable POSIX service removal, including offline login managers.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/setup_gui.py Python A GTK frontend using distribution Python; installation stays in packaged lifecycle commands.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/setup_output.py Python A Private, redacted installation transcripts and live subprocess output (stdlib only).
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/setup_wizard.py Python A Shared Debian setup coordinator. Frontends own prompts; lifecycle owns installation.
build/runtime/smto_bootstrap/system.py Python A Provision platform prerequisites and private command-line clients for compiled setup. Select an available package manager, install configured recipes, and record package/client evidence; callers own consent and the overall dependency transaction. Private Docker extraction selects client executables, and the MacPorts fallback builds only PostgreSQL client targets. System package effects are external to generation receipts and are not rolled back by a failed setup.
build/tools/acceptance.py Python A Exercise exact artifacts in isolated per-user storage; record only observed checks.
build/tools/compliance.py Python A Conservative license BOM and exact-evidence release gate.
build/tools/components.py Python A Compiled component contracts. Portal dependencies and lifecycle stay independent.

build/tools/create_server_update.py Python A Create an immutable update descriptor for one compiled server variant.

Probe the existing Python and selected local Docker endpoint, install missing packages on supported Ubuntu/Debian hosts, and require Compose/Buildx readiness. Export the selected socket and sudo requirement for the child installer without changing contexts. Administrative actions use root or noninteractive sudo. A default system daemon may be started; unavailable Desktop/rootless services and conflicting engines fail explicitly. Package/repository changes are not rolled back here; temporary repository files are removed on the handled download/install failure paths. Deployment data belongs to the caller. Host preparation for install-website.sh; sourceable so tests can mock commands. Only missing prerequisites are installed. Existing Docker contexts and data stay intact.

src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/google.py Python A Expose safe Google Workspace account and browser-consent HTTP routes.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/http_connections.py Python A Expose HTTP Connection settings through bounded JSON routes backed by Parameter Store and the existing HTTP capabilities. src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/integrations.py Python A Serve non-streaming integration responses through the Controller’s existing request and trace owners. IntegrationRoutes submits work, returns current snapshots and delegates confirmation/clarification continuations; a bounded post-submission wait can yield HTTP 202 while execution continues. Helpers map trace states and raw-output previews without becoming a task store, idempotency layer or independent privacy boundary. Runtime schemas and handler docstrings remain unchanged because HTTP tooling consumes them.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/memories.py Python A Expose the human Memory Editor API through the existing authenticated Controller application. Strict payload models carry content as text, explicit format, optional metadata/project binding and expected revisions. MemoryRoutes binds the shared RAM store, maps domain failures to HTTP status and attaches asynchronous checkpoint targets after successful mutations. Inventory search uses the editor full-value snapshot, separate from Agent metadata search. The existing portal middleware owns authentication/CSRF; handlers neither call a model nor dispatch Memory tools.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/microsoft365.py Python A Expose Microsoft account summaries and bounded browser consent routes.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/monitor_service.py Python A Wire the shared monitor manager into Controller services, app state and the runtime. MonitorService supplies stores, Gateway selection/working-directory resolution, task dispatch and configured auxiliary model providers; its small projection and lifecycle wrappers reuse manager behavior and map typed errors to HTTP responses. Initialization creates no monitor worker. The manager and stores retain execution, revision and recovery ownership.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/monitors.py Python A Expose monitor drafts, creation, inspection, observation streams and lifecycle/definition management through HTTP. MonitorRoutes validates filters and single-Gateway scope, applies accepted behavior settings and optionally resolves a prompt-only creation draft before calling the shared manager. Revision-checked patches/deletion preserve captured authority and reject stale or active work. Routes serialize existing records and map typed errors; manager workers, stores and Gateway transport own execution and recovery.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/native.py Python A Expose authoritative run snapshots and native lifecycle controls to both UI clients.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/parallel_execution.py Python A Scoped parallel settings and retained-batch recovery in the Agent Checks UI.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/parameter_binding_reviews.py Python A Expose authenticated, save-only reviews of successful recorded parameter bindings. Strict request models carry exact request/run/invocation identity, observed and saved revisions, explicit source choices and idempotency identity. Routes delegate evidence, preview and approval to BindingReviews; unavailable stores and review conflicts return HTTP 409. Application middleware owns authentication, while this module adds no correction session, pause/resume or tool-dispatch endpoint.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/parameter_mappings.py Python A Expose explicit correction, remembered mapping and learned-workflow operations. Strict payloads carry revisions, idempotency keys and reviewed source choices. Passive eligibility/inspection and preview delegate to Corrections without task control; explicit start/select/apply/cancel use its pause and recovery rules. Library edits/feedback use versioned mapping documents. Learned-workflow preview, save and launch remain separate from saved-request Workflow APIs. Application middleware supplies authentication; review/storage conflicts become HTTP 409.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/parameters.py Python A Serve Parameter Store management, detached templates, exact-reference suggestions and editable drafts through the shared API services. Handlers distinguish policy-projected summaries from explicit audited raw reveal, and preserve current HTTP literal-profile replacement semantics. List statistics are bounded; ordinary editor updates have no revision precondition. The store owns validation, persistence and session invalidation, while the shared auxiliary client owns model drafting admission. Outer web authentication remains outside this route class.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/prompt_cache.py Python A Serve prompt-cache policy evidence, previews and explicitly admitted synthetic comparisons. Read endpoints do not dispatch inference, while start uses the existing update/admission guard and returns cancellable job state.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/prompts.py Python A Serve Prompt Editor inspection, search, preview and optimistic-concurrency writes. src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/readiness.py Python A Expose the controller startup check and remembered Gateway availability.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/recipes.py Python A Expose current saved-request Workflows through shared Controller stores, policies and durable tasks. src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/request_lifecycle.py Python A Own the HTTP bridge between accepted user intent, native run progression and retained presentation. It also serves bounded trace/activity views, retained command/model output and reconnectable SSE. QueueSubmissions, permission/capability authorities, human_input and runtime_flow own the underlying transactions and execution. Separate write/launch failures can leave accepted state behind; retry must use its identity. Read projections never establish tool success.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/resource_locking.py Python A Expose revisioned locking settings and synchronize enabled Gateways.
src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/resource_reconciliation.py Python A Serialize revision-bound resource recovery and explicit unsafe confirmations.

src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/runs.py Python A Maintain current-run records and their browser-facing execution projections.

src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/scheduled_event_shared.py Python A Bridge accepted schedule occurrences into ordinary Agent task execution. src/agent_runtime/api/agent_ui_support/route_groups/task_summary.py Python A Task-scoped retrospective summaries using the existing native result storage.

src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/mobile/lazy/queue.js JavaScript A Show and mutate the selected conversation's server-owned queue in a mobile sheet. open projects a cached/read lane into task rows; action sends edits, reordering, steering or explicit starts and refreshes the canonical owner before rebuilding. updateStart follows current dependency/version evidence; clear deletes only queued intent. hooks supplies refresh/renderComposer and receives one owned laneChanged callback, removed when this sheet closes or is replaced. Initial reads and replacement are fenced by navigation/mounted-body identity. Live invalidations update existing dependency/start controls without replacing an active editor; full row inventories refresh on reopening. Button owners serialize their own actions and present errors. No polling, task scheduling or cancellation of accepted server work occurs when this view closes.

src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/mobile/streaming.js JavaScript A Own mobile run trace streams and the page's separate invalidation connection.
src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/mobile/submission_options.js JavaScript A Capture mobile execution intent before an asynchronous submission begins. submissionOptions joins the loaded composer profile and target registry with current policy drafts and Agent Checks overrides. src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/mobile/task_dependencies.js JavaScript A Project server-owned dependency intent for the dedicated mobile composer. This shell loads its own entry point with the same selection contract as desktop: composer merges scoped tasks, choices feeds the resource palette, and render keeps an explicit Run After identity visible even when it becomes unavailable. reset returns a revision-guarded restoration callback for failed submissions; describe supplies readable blocker evidence to the queue sheet and task views. src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/model_routing.js JavaScript A Share Main/Helper/Vision cards between Inference and Settings. src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/native_controls.js JavaScript A Join native run snapshots to explicit desktop task and context controls. Snapshot readers/renderers project server lifecycle authority, per-request pending actions, context metadata, public OAuth interaction and operation progress. They use the canonical conversation owner when available, with revision-fenced fallback reads for legacy/direct requests. Observation does not itself start model work. Command helpers send Pause, Stop, Resume, continuation, retry and compaction intent to its server owner, then reconcile accepted state. Acknowledgement is distinct from final execution or termination; failed Stop delivery remains uncertain. Attachment helpers retain bounded next-request metadata and reject late selection after scope/lock changes, while accepted uploads/grants remain server-owned. init binds page-lived callbacks once and joins shared invalidations. The foreground timer updates elapsed text only; no timer polls task state. There is no public dispose method. task_lifecycle.js supplies action projection and stable buttons; app.js supplies conversation, presentation, resource and acceptance hooks.

src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/navigation_groups.js JavaScript A Share navigation disclosures and optional responsive Sections dialogs across shells. Each root has one controller. Only explicit summary activation changes validated tab-session collapse preferences; search and deep-link reveal adjust presentation temporarily. Narrow menus move the existing panel into a native modal and restore its home/focus on close or resize. Callers own filtering, destination navigation and closing after selection. The controller performs no server write or task action.

src/agent_runtime/api/static/agent_ui/notification_delivery.js JavaScript A Own page-lived notification observation and optional browser alert delivery. Canonical history, unread status and product enablement come from the API. Initial hydration is silent; later eligible identities enter a pending delivery queue. Recent identity/timestamp metadata, optional Web Locks and BroadcastChannel reduce duplicate cross-tab alerts without storing message content or acknowledging reads. Shared update invalidations trigger coalesced reads; native/toast delivery, explicit permission requests and inbox mutations remain separate operations.

Consume the shared delivery service's canonical snapshot, apply local search/filter preferences and retain card expansion/focus through updates. Explicit read/dismiss actions and bounded deep-link resolution delegate to the delivery service; copying or expanding content does not acknowledge it. A separate coalesced event read selects three saved direct reminders without predicting or executing scheduled work. The document owns subscriptions and resize observation for its page lifetime.

src/agent_runtime/artifacts/init.py Python A Package boundary for generated-file publication, registry access and lifecycle services. Importing this package adds no worker or registry; runtime/API owners construct the concrete services. The immutable file versions here are separate from tool-result evidence and from the repository's top-level generated artifacts folder.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/api.py Python A Serve scoped generated files through portal ownership and artifact-specific credentials.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/collector.py Python A One deterministic reconciler for foreground tools and durable job termination.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/config.py Python A Define validated artifact storage and export quotas for registry/collector callers. Environment defaults are evaluated when ArtifactLimits is constructed; settings may supply explicit values. Positive byte/count bounds reject invalid configuration without allocating files.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/export.py Python A Build authorized run-scoped ZIP downloads from each logical path’s latest version and an allowlisted manifest. Sanitize extraction names, reject unavailable members and enforce conservative preflight plus actual output limits. Private temporary staging completes and rechecks authorization before streaming; exports include sensitive bytes under the same download permission.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/maintenance.py Python A Apply conversation artifact-retention policy without making request reads scan the filesystem. The worker delegates active-controller cleanup to the RAM save/checkpoint coordinator; standalone SQL retains its serialized maintenance pass. Active, uncertain, scheduled and referenced work protects files. Policy updates and metadata retirement are separate from eventual physical removal, and errors remain visible for later retry.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/materialize.py Python A Transfer a verified current-run artifact to a unique PDF destination inside the selected Gateway workspace. Scoped authenticated transfer checks chunk offsets and final digest; cancellation/errors return a locality limitation while preserving the Controller artifact. The caller receives usable paths only after commit.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/memory_maintenance.py Python A Prepare or perform artifact cleanup through per-namespace RAM ownership fences. Retention projections join native, task, schedule and monitor protection; file IO happens outside optimistic hub callbacks. A configured save/cleanup planner binds retirement and removal to recovery evidence, while fallback passes yield between units when foreground execution starts.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/memory_store.py Python A Keep artifact version, scope, quota, session and collection metadata on the shared Controller RAM authority. Immutable blobs live on disk; registration performs slow IO before a retryable metadata publication that rechecks ownership and quotas. Derived indexes support summaries, ordered history and expiry. Failed or deduplicated publication cleans staging while crash leftovers remain maintenance work.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/metadata.py Python A Share the artifact metadata-patch shape guard between RAM and standalone SQL registries. The validator permits only display name, explicit sensitivity and retirement, with an integer expected revision. Registry transactions still own run scope and compare-and-update authority.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/presentation.py Python A Enrich completed answers with registered attachments without changing canonical completion evidence. project may collect concrete missing outputs on their original targets; retained_projection uses saved bindings only for history. Plan responses keep their digest-bound form, and optional attachment failure leaves the original answer intact.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/preview.py Python A Choose safe display modes and bounded data previews for immutable registered artifacts. MIME, sensitivity and byte ceilings determine eligibility; CSV/JSON/text readers expose truncation and formatting limits. Returned text is presentation data, not executed code, and contains the authorized original values rather than model-redacted copies.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/references.py Python A Extract bounded concrete output paths and enrich display Markdown using saved artifact bindings. Receipt traversal excludes execution inputs and diagnostics; assistant fenced examples stay inert. Paths are candidates only: this module performs no filesystem access, Gateway call, registration or execution.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/runtime.py Python A Connect native run identity to artifact workspaces on the selected execution target. Bind registry context, negotiate workspace/temp support, validate chunked remote reads and translate Files paths. Explicit local adapters are the only Controller-local fallback; transfer/protocol failures prevent publication rather than changing targets.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/source_capture.py Python A Publish executed Python attempts’ exact submitted source as immutable artifacts. The collector supplies the operation producer and sensitivity; capture derives a stable source path and sends UTF-8 bytes to the registry. No generated execution wrapper or resolved input values are substituted.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/store.py Python A Own generated-file namespaces, immutable versions, scoped grants and verified download streams. ArtifactStore selects the RAM adapter for an active Controller and retains standalone SQL behavior otherwise. Registration stages and hashes bounded bytes before publishing metadata/events; reads verify a private copy before serving. Preview policy and retention are separate owners, and publication never proves task completion.
src/agent_runtime/artifacts/temp_publication.py Python A Stage finalized task-temp files and explicit output references through the original target’s artifact protocol. Saved collector state retains source/staged revisions, sensitivity, retry status and final registry associations. Bounded staging and conservative provenance separate finding a path from proving its producer; history uses retained IDs without resolving old paths again.

src/agent_runtime/auth/oauth2.py Python A Implement bounded OAuth/OIDC protocol exchanges and trusted metadata validation.
src/agent_runtime/auth/privacy.py Python A Project OAuth, provider account and Email authority without exposing credential fields.
src/agent_runtime/auth/profiles.py Python A Validate version-one OAuth client/connection records and detached setup templates.
src/agent_runtime/behavior_policy.py Python A Capture task approach independently of model sampling and execution authority. Typed presets guide research, planning, dependencies, verification and evidence; retained snapshots survive later preset changes. Guidance projection and per-family result streaks provide bounded recovery hints without changing receipts, retry limits or completion truth. Runtime guidance strings remain source-owned prompt inputs and are preserved verbatim.
src/agent_runtime/branding.py Python A Validated presentation identity. No settings, permissions or prompt policy live here.
src/agent_runtime/branding_web.py Python A Escaped shell projection shared as data by independent browser presentations.

src/agent_runtime/capabilities/registry.py Python A Register deterministic tools atomically and expose detached contract snapshots.
src/agent_runtime/capability_policy.py Python A Compile explicit capability selections into deterministic run envelopes.
src/agent_runtime/capability_scopes.py Python A Resolve and persist capability defaults and selection preferences across settings and conversations. CapabilityAuthority shares the Controller RAM hub or a standalone attached-SQL transaction, enforces optimistic revisions, and supports acceptance-time snapshots plus live dispatch restrictions. Defaults edits do not rewrite accepted runs; legacy conversation grants join the caller transaction while new resource grants have task-only ownership elsewhere.
src/agent_runtime/capability_selection.py Python A Freeze routing settings and a compact, digested tool ceiling at acceptance, then project model- selected Skills within it. Resume restores server-owned snapshots and explicit core-tool migrations; it does not rerun selection or import new defaults. Availability, permissions, credentials and task-resource grants remain separate owners. Functions mutate accepted/resume state only where documented and perform no network probing.
src/agent_runtime/code_context.py Python A Versioned Code-only admission policy. Accepted snapshots survive rollout and retries.
src/agent_runtime/code_execution_scope.py Python A Code execution facts. Code uses the Agent's permissions; there is no extra scope gate.
src/agent_runtime/code_execution_status.py Python A Idempotent Code reply projection from runtime facts, never from model claims.
src/agent_runtime/code_profile.py Python A Versioned Code behavior; settings remain owned by the parent conversation.
src/agent_runtime/code_workspaces.py Python A Server-owned workspace/thread bindings and the coder's unconditional context ceiling.
src/agent_runtime/commands/init.py Python A Expose the shared contracts, registry and parser for human application controls. The package separates slash commands from model tools, skills and prompt macros. Consumers register concrete handlers through the control plane and HTTP adapter; importing this module does not dispatch commands, contact Gateways or start model work.
src/agent_runtime/commands/control_plane.py Python A Translate human application controls into validated client actions over injected conversation, task and native stores. CommandControlPlane verifies exact selected ownership/availability under the queue lock and revalidates mutation targets at the native control endpoint. status returns bounded persisted measurements without inference. Restart has its own coordinator so it can begin despite busy work; clients own navigation and normal confirmation dialogs.
src/agent_runtime/commands/models.py Python A Define the human command request/result and discovery contracts. CommandContext constrains untrusted IDs, CommandInvocation carries parsed input, and CommandDefinition declares handler metadata. CommandResult validates typed client actions and separates public response fields from server-only post-response work. Registry and control-plane owners validate names, availability and actual target relationships; schemas and runtime descriptions remain the public compatibility surface.
src/agent_runtime/commands/registry.py Python A Parse and dispatch exact human slash commands without entering model execution. CommandRegistry owns validated canonical names/aliases and ordered discovery metadata, invokes one registered handler and emits bounded diagnostics. Quoted arguments are parsed as text, never executed by a shell. Unknown or malformed commands return explicit errors; handler failures do not expose their exception details or raw inputs through diagnostics.
src/agent_runtime/commands/restart.py Python A Coordinate backend and enabled-Gateway restart or shutdown for slash and legacy API callers. gateway_target normalizes deduplication identities; restart_gateway/shutdown_gateway report per-target management outcomes. RestartCoordinator coalesces requests of either kind, defers durable Controller shutdown until after acknowledgement and invokes process handoff or exit only after confirmed saving. Failures remain visible for retry without resending accepted remote requests; callbacks support isolated tests and embedded hosts.
src/agent_runtime/commands/stop.py Python A Resolve explicit Stop targets without mutating runs or consulting UI list order.
src/agent_runtime/console/init.py Python A Expose the diagnostic publisher and lazily load the sidecar application factory. Main-server callers can import heartbeat/event adapters without importing the sampler and HTTP routes. The package owns no background process or sampler at import time; startup and the sidecar lifespan own those resources.
src/agent_runtime/console/app.py Python A Serve the independent diagnostic console over the installation login boundary. create_console_app resolves target/port settings, owns a process sampler and UDP collector through lifespan, and exposes cached snapshots, an optional SSE stream and explicit stack capture. Page/static handlers use installed branding and error assets. Snapshot requests do not query GPU hardware; the sampling thread does. This app reports observations and cannot settle tasks or authorize execution.
src/agent_runtime/console/collector.py Python A Receive best-effort diagnostic datagrams for the console sampler. ConsoleUdpCollector owns one IPv4 UDP socket and daemon receiver thread. It accepts JSON objects, ignores malformed packets and recorder failures, and delegates target PID/process-birth filtering to the sampler. Transport supplies no delivery acknowledgement, replay or sender authentication; HTTP login does not wrap UDP.
src/agent_runtime/console/diagnosis.py Python A Classify visible console measurements without inference or execution authority. diagnose consumes one snapshot and returns at most eight severity-ranked findings with observed evidence and a next check. Fixed thresholds cover missing process, heartbeat age, CPU/memory, occupied slots, stage hints and recent HTTP latency. These heuristics suggest investigations; they do not prove root cause, restart services, dispatch tools or determine whether a task effect succeeded.
src/agent_runtime/console/gpu.py Python A Sample device-wide local NVIDIA telemetry in the sidecar worker. NvidiaGpuProvider uses one fixed nvidia-smi CSV query with a 0.75-second subprocess timeout and the shared GPU parser. Failed or empty observations clear readings and delay another attempt for 30 seconds. Aggregate utilization is the maximum available device reading; VRAM is summed used/total across usable devices. These values are host observations, not Agent-process attribution or Gateway inventory.
src/agent_runtime/console/publisher.py Python A Publish main-server diagnostics without making the console an execution owner. ConsoleDiagnostics owns an independent thread heartbeat, asyncio lag probe and optional SIGUSR2 faulthandler registration. HTTP middleware times response creation; ConsoleEventSink can mirror supplied pipeline events after log-policy projection and size limits. ConsolePublisher sends process-identified UDP packets without acknowledgement or retry, retaining send errors locally. Heartbeat summaries are bounded store observations, not a durable event journal or complete task history.
src/agent_runtime/console/sampler.py Python A Join independent process/GPU samples with best-effort main-server observations. ConsoleSampler pins the target PID and its initial OS birth time for packet acceptance, maintains bounded sample/event/stack rings, and projects cached snapshots through deterministic diagnosis. Heartbeats replace current run facts; pipeline hints are merged separately and may outlive an active run. Stack capture signals the configured PID and reads an append-only shared log. Snapshot reads do not collect hardware data, persist controller state or authorize recovery.
src/agent_runtime/console/static/console.css CSS A Agent UI reference tokens, served entirely by the Console sidecar.
src/agent_runtime/console/static/console.html HTML A Provide the authenticated diagnostic console shell for process bottlenecks, active requests and system observations.
src/agent_runtime/console/static/console.js JavaScript A Present the independent console's cached process, GPU and diagnostic observations. Poll JSON every second with overlapping reads coalesced, render literal-text cards and timestamped charts, and send stack capture only on explicit activation. The backend owns sampling, diagnosis and signals. This browser neither consumes the optional SSE endpoint nor controls task execution; absent readings stay visible as gaps/placeholders. Shared error/busy adapters own request feedback.

src/agent_runtime/current_run/activity_watchdogs.py Python A Own retained per-job observation schedules and health/attention evidence across RAM and standalone SQLite stores. Registration, token claims, compare-and-merge publication and incident acknowledgement coordinate the external activity_watchdog worker. Completion probes and health sampling have independent clocks, while exact physical proof controls settlement. The retained runtime docstring below describes the standalone SQL schema; hub-backed WatchdogStore instances use memory_watchdogs and share the evidence merge rules.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/completion_mailbox.py Python A Deliver ordered Activity completions to an owned Agent decision without losing or double- consuming a batch. The public helpers dispatch RAM Records and hub-backed stores to memory_mailbox; the SQL implementation supports standalone stores. Event append, stable delivery identity and exact cursor acknowledgement are distinct operations. The historical SQLite wording in the retained runtime docstring below describes only that backend.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/execution_observation.py Python A Explain retained execution state to status APIs without executing or recovering work. ExecutionObservation.inspect resolves scoped identities and combines native, scheduler, receipt, trace and watchdog facts; progress_facts classifies freshness and presentation prepares UI labels. Missing, ambiguous and malformed locators remain distinct failures. Admission does not prove process liveness, and unknown progress is preserved instead of invented.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/job_observation.py Python A Read an existing job and terminal receipt without recovery or Gateway access.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/journal_scope.py Python A Keep native transcript ownership separate from the visible chat identity. Scope resolution and durable journal bindings let independent tasks share a chat without borrowing each other's execution evidence; read paths require explicit lineage, and retention enumerates only recorded ownership.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/lifecycle_projection.py Python A Translate checkpoint, Activity, job and resource-queue facts into UI lifecycle phases and allowed actions. read_work gathers a consistent backend view, work_facts reconciles physical identities, and project separates semantic outcome from physical settlement. repair_legacy is the explicit exceptional path: it mutates a supplied checkpoint only for proven historical owner-contention partials, leaving persistence to its caller.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_agent_turns.py Python A Manage model-turn capacity leases and execution-phase projections in the Controller's RAM authority. MemoryAgentTurns adapts the shared AgentTurns admission rules, cancellation checks and wake notifications; transaction callbacks own lease changes, while provider execution occurs in the caller's leased block.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_artifact_metadata.py Python A Maintain the metadata-only artifact discovery index as native results, aliases and run scopes change. NativeRecords invokes the projection hooks inside its transaction; list_artifacts reads a coherent conversation view and returns bounded public metadata without loading result bodies.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_capability_events.py Python A Keep capability outbox events in stable per-run sequence order in RAM. NativeRecords updates the index with each event mutation; consumers page detached payloads after their last cursor, while delivery acknowledgement remains outside this module.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_context_metadata.py Python A Index attachment sources, enforce conversation grants and produce bounded context-discovery metadata. NativeRecords owns transactional index updates; ContextStore owns the immutable body files. Discovery and grant reads exclude tombstoned owners and do not read attachment content.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_continuation.py Python A Maintain coalesced run readiness, dependency subscriptions and process-local deadlines in the native RAM authority. Transaction helpers retain timer and Stop expiration facts and expose bounded work batches; MemoryContinuationWorker performs reconciliation and resume decisions outside those transactions.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_conversation_references.py Python A Maintain a derived conversation-to-run index in the same transaction as each checkpoint mutation. Deletion and management readers use these memberships to find affected execution identities without scanning full run state.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_execution_observation.py Python A Resolve execution locators against derived indexes in one immutable native snapshot. The reader intersects caller scopes, rejects missing or ambiguous ownership and returns allowlisted state/activity/job/receipt facts for ExecutionObservation; it neither probes a Gateway nor advances a run.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_gateway_references.py Python A Project live native runs and their Gateway dependencies for management and update admission. Hooks from NativeRecords account for jobs, continuations and tombstones, apply update guards and retain only small identity fields; Settings does not traverse model transcripts or tool payloads.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_ledger.py Python A Keep UI reconnect records, selection, status counts and ordered history in the existing native RAM domain. MemoryCurrentRunStore preserves standalone ledger semantics while using atomic projection updates and coherent joins to task/native state, rather than opening runtime SQLite connections.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_mailbox.py Python A Deliver terminal activity events through a replayable per-run mailbox committed with receipt state. Append and import preserve sequence identity; prepare publishes a bounded delivery draft, and consume advances its exact cursor with the owning decision transaction.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_policy.py Python A Capture prompt permission policy and amend a waiting run's grant in the same RAM authority as its checkpoint. The module delegates normalization and matching to permission_policy, checks exact pending-operation identity, and commits conversation policy changes atomically when that grant scope is requested.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_receipt_metadata.py Python A Maintain stable receipt cursors and an index of unresolved Gateway transfers. NativeRecords updates both indexes with receipt changes; recovery callers receive copied candidates from bounded continuation ancestry and decide separately whether any physical reconciliation is safe.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_run_history.py Python A Track native-run creation order, conversation membership and busy-command identities in RAM. Checkpoint mutations update these projections transactionally; UI history pages use stable cursors so repeated saves do not reorder accepted runs.
src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_schema.py Python A Translate native SQLite recovery tables into the RAM repository's record schemas. src/agent_runtime/current_run/memory_state.py Python A Isolate retryable run-state mutations from the execution owner's live objects. src/agent_runtime/events/management.py Python A Share deterministic schedule inspection, edits, lifecycle actions and triggering between HTTP and native tools. src/agent_runtime/execution/guidance_compact.py Python A Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/policy.py Python A Validate compact-guidance preferences and publish immutable request policies. GuidanceOwner retains the last accepted settings, diagnoses invalid startup input and supplies snapshots to selection.py; prompt wording and editor override persistence belong to prompts/.
src/agent_runtime/guidance/projection.py Python A Apply exact path-and-original-text replacements to detached outgoing structures. changes records differing string leaves from paired producer outputs; apply copies only changed containers, leaving stored objects and unrelated values intact.
src/agent_runtime/guidance/protocol.py Python A Project the canonical system protocol while retaining independently owned sudo, status, efficiency and Task Context instructions. Exact full-protocol recognition protects custom and historical text; this module does not change protocol facts or tool schemas.
src/agent_runtime/guidance/selection.py Python A Bind compact choices and Prompt Editor overrides to a logical model request. Source selection checks exact release fingerprints, records bounded fallback reasons and supplies cache identities; canonical-history scopes suppress outgoing projection.
src/agent_runtime/guidance/tools.py Python A Select outgoing tool-description wording on caller-detached declarations. ToolCatalog supplies canonical capability identities; wait controls retain their separately selectable ordering suffix. Shared registry metadata must be copied before calling.
src/agent_runtime/guidance_compact.py Python A Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.
src/agent_runtime/kv/init.py Python A Expose KVStore and KVError for storage consumers. The facade selects the active RAM owner or standalone SQLite only when constructed; importing this package performs no scratch read/write, scope binding or inference.
src/agent_runtime/kv/lifecycle.py Python A Retire scratch scopes in the same transaction as accepted task/conversation deletion. scopes_for_runs captures indexed ownership and deterministic fallback scopes before their rows disappear; exclusive mode preserves scopes still owned by another run. retire_scopes_in fences late access immediately and optionally erases values/counters through the SQL or RAM owner. This layer does not infer authority from chat chronology or start its own transaction.
src/agent_runtime/kv/memory_store.py Python A Own task scratch notes in the Controller RAM hub. MemoryKVStore publishes per-scope revisions, lazy expiry, quota checks and note changes atomically, then emits value-free metadata outside the transaction. Explicit reads return values, search returns bounded snippets and list returns keys. Deletion retains a scope tombstone; repository shares one owner per hub/recovery path. Legacy conversation column names remain for compatibility, but current tool scope comes from accepted task ownership. Live SQL access is forbidden.
src/agent_runtime/kv/models.py Python A Define shared validation and capacity limits for task scratch notes. normalize_key lowercases exact bounded ASCII identities; validate_value preserves valid Unicode text under a 16 KiB UTF-8 limit; positive_integer rejects booleans and coerced revisions/TTLs. KVError carries stable diagnostic kinds. reject_secrets is a compatibility no-op, so guidance about non-secret scratch work is not enforced by this validator. No storage, redaction or model calls occur here.
src/agent_runtime/kv/store.py Python A Provide the KVStore owner-routing facade, standalone SQLite operations and recovery schema initializer. Construction returns an explicit/registered RAM owner first; unowned paths use local SQL transactions. Both backends enforce text/byte/count bounds, per-task monotonic put revisions, optional compare-and-set, lazy expiry and deletion fences. Search scans capped key/value text and list uses lexical cursors. The caller supplies scope authority; historical column names do not give conversations access to current task notes.
src/agent_runtime/legal/init.py Python A Versioned clickwrap acceptance, outside the Agent execution loop.
src/agent_runtime/legal/routes.py Python A Small authoritative legal API; acceptance cannot edit client-selected records.
src/agent_runtime/legal/service.py Python A Backend-owned, append-only legal acceptance for the existing local controller.
src/agent_runtime/llm/init.py Python A LLM boundary interfaces for structured calls and repair.
src/agent_runtime/llm/answer_stream.py Python A Project eligible native answer fragments into batched cumulative UI callbacks. src/agent_runtime/llm/brain_freeze.py Python A Carry live decision controls and numeric soft-target observations without retaining private reasoning. src/agent_runtime/llm/budget.py Python A Own request-local inference accounting across execution and internal phases. src/agent_runtime/llm/budget_growth.py Python A Expose the native recovery owner's effective output and thinking allowances through request-local context. src/agent_runtime/llm/client.py Python A LLM client interfaces.
src/agent_runtime/llm/continuation.py Python A Retain bounded unfinished assistant prefixes privately after an eligible token-limit stop. Unsupported shapes hand off to ordinary bounded recovery; no partial tool executes and no reasoning prefix enters durable history.
src/agent_runtime/llm/discovery.py Python A Share process-local model metadata discovery across UI and native callers using single-flight futures and a 45-second successful-result cache. Cache invalidation fences stale publication without cancelling its loader.
src/agent_runtime/llm/generation.py Python A Resolve phase-specific generation timing/thinking policy and detect stalled or repetitive private reasoning or extreme unfinished tool-argument loops before response acceptance. src/agent_runtime/llm/guidance_compact.py Python A Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.
src/agent_runtime/llm/message_stream.py Python A Scan fragmented JSON solely to preview its top-level message string. src/agent_runtime/llm/modalities.py Python A Interpret explicit active serving metadata for primary-model image input. src/agent_runtime/llm/model_configuration.py Python A Define the generation-parameter catalog, validate explicit maps and resolve saved presets. src/agent_runtime/llm/model_output_capture.py Python A Capture provider-emitted text for the on-demand inspector, separate from public answer/history projection. src/agent_runtime/llm/named_result.py Python A Validate and extract bounded internal model results as data. src/agent_runtime/llm/native_protocol.py Python A Validate complete native response wrappers and parse unambiguous argument objects before execution can be considered. src/agent_runtime/llm/native_stream.py Python A Reconstruct one native response from SSE fragments, with bounded call identities and private reasoning observations. src/agent_runtime/llm/native_tool_client.py Python A Native tool and internal-result transport over the compatible HTTP client.

src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/capabilities.py Python A Retain bounded compatibility evidence and materialize detached provider requests after explicit setup rejection. src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/context.py Python A Measure bound chat requests through optional non-generating vendor adapters and active serving- capacity metadata. src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/llama_reasoning.py Python A Discover llama.cpp reasoning fields through pre-inference request validation.
src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/reasoning.py Python A Interpret serving metadata and non-generating validation for optional reasoning controls. src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/response.py Python A Normalize harmless provider representation differences into one controller-owned response envelope. src/agent_runtime/llm/product_profile.py Python A Normalize endpoint model selection and internal context/output allowances. src/agent_runtime/llm/profiling.py Python A Wrap structured complete_json calls with request-local duration, character-based token estimates, prompt fingerprints and section-size accounting. src/agent_runtime/llm/provider_diagnostics.py Python A Translate provider/transport failures into causal categories and safe public shape facts. src/agent_runtime/llm/readiness.py Python A Own one advisory model compatibility report per controller startup.
src/agent_runtime/llm/readiness_budget.py Python A Bound startup probe time, dispatch attempts and output tokens.
src/agent_runtime/llm/readiness_probes.py Python A Run one bounded synthetic tool-call protocol check without executing tools.
src/agent_runtime/llm/reasoning_control.py Python A Apply supported server thinking limits or control one explicitly identified live llama.cpp completion. Control failures leave the original stream running; public events contain numeric state and IDs rather than reasoning or credentials.
src/agent_runtime/llm/repetition.py Python A Bounded character-pattern detection, independent of transport chunks or language.
src/agent_runtime/llm/reproducibility.py Python A Produce deterministic SHA-256 fingerprints for prompt/manifest telemetry using sorted JSON keys and existing array order. src/agent_runtime/llm/request_lifecycle.py Python A Fence request dispatch and account only actual inference attempts.

src/agent_runtime/llm/response_deadline.py Python A Enforce an explicitly configured total budget while the nonstreaming transport opens and reads a generation response. src/agent_runtime/llm/router.py Python A Select typed Main/Helper/Vision destinations before context preparation and provider negotiation. src/agent_runtime/llm/schema_hints.py Python A Serialize full schemas for structured prompts, remove exact redundant embedded schema copies, and expose a separate bounded lossy hint builder. src/agent_runtime/llm/sse.py Python A Decode OpenAI-shaped SSE data with strict UTF-8, JSON-object framing and event/stream byte limits. src/agent_runtime/llm/stream_activity.py Python A Convert observed native data-event arrivals into bounded, content-free receipt and token-history projections. A locked per-call recorder batches cumulative buckets, flushes a silent tail and refines earlier input/output estimates from provider metadata. It owns publication timing, not inference, execution or task completion.
src/agent_runtime/llm/stream_settlement.py Python A Settle a rejected generation before allowing a bounded recovery request.
src/agent_runtime/llm/structured_call.py Python A Helpers for validating structured LLM output.
src/agent_runtime/llm/thinking_reminder.py Python A Final agent instructions, kept out of history and bounded visual observations.
src/agent_runtime/llm/token_telemetry.py Python A Extract optional numerical token and processing-time evidence from supported OpenAI-shaped response metadata. src/agent_runtime/llm/tracing.py Python A LLM client wrapper that emits operational trace events.
src/agent_runtime/llm/unavailable.py Python A Retain a failing model client while controller settings remain accessible.
src/agent_runtime/managed_settings.py Python A Persist revisioned startup overrides independently of running settings and editable workspace paths. Merge patches over a validated bootstrap model, resolve secret environment references only for effective use and present configured markers publicly. Cross-process file locking serializes revision checks, lifecycle hooks and atomic replacement; callers restart services and own any separate relocation recovery.
src/agent_runtime/memory_permission_scopes.py Python A Implement live Controller permission authority over immutable RAM views and atomic cross-domain writes. Grants, revisions and bounded audit records publish with run state; checkpoints preserve those domains separately from this runtime API.
src/agent_runtime/mentions.py Python A Keep browser shortcuts and server parameter parsing on one namespace/literal grammar. registry_payload supplies composer metadata; normalization and reservation prevent saved parameters from shadowing actions. without_literals masks code/escaped mentions without moving offsets, and parameter_mentions yields valid tokens without reading a parameter store.
src/agent_runtime/model_credential_diagnostics.py Python A Bounded missing-reference evidence without provider secrets or automatic credential repair.
src/agent_runtime/model_routing.py Python A Own revisioned Main/Helper/Vision connections and call-type assignments in shared Settings authority. Public updates reject stale revisions; accepted work retains its connection and credential version while new work captures current settings.

src/agent_runtime/monitors/drafting.py Python A Propose and validate monitor settings for the explicit draft/create workflow. src/agent_runtime/monitors/management.py Python A Share revision-checked monitor definition edits between RAM and standalone stores. DefinitionPatch permits only named definition fields with bounded values and rejects empty/null patches; check requires the exact observed revision and a stopped record before mutation or deletion. The manager additionally checks worker liveness. This path retains captured authority and does not restart execution, redraft commands or rerun the full creation heuristics.
src/agent_runtime/monitors/manager.py Python A Coordinate monitor workers, Gateway terminals, condition evaluation and linked action tasks. AgentMonitorManager owns thread/cancellation handles and judge cadence, while the store owns definitions and evidence. Sampling collects completed commands; streaming evaluates individual arriving chunks. Optional model judgement has cadence, confidence and native lifetime-budget gates. Duration and stop requests are cooperative, trigger effects span separate stores/callbacks, and bounded history helpers have documented prefix limits. Restart interruption records recovery state without automatically resuming remote work.
src/agent_runtime/monitors/memory_store.py Python A Implement monitor lifecycle and observation/trigger history on the live Controller RAM authority. MonitorRecords maintains status, visibility, sequence and trigger indexes within atomic publications; MemoryMonitorStore provides revision checks, observation-pointer updates, judge-budget reservations and creation-time pruning of settled history. Detached records prevent callers mutating authoritative state. RecordRepository imports recovery tables and the shared checkpoint owner saves them; live access never falls back to SQLite or launches Gateway work.
src/agent_runtime/monitors/models.py Python A Define monitor draft/create/update, persisted observation/trigger and structured judgement contracts. monitor_gateway_context validates captured single-Gateway intent; creation also normalizes title and behavior policy, while draft requests reject public model-route overrides. Pydantic schemas describe data, not command execution or authorization. The manager applies command/duration heuristics, confidence/cadence rules and lifecycle effects; stores encode records and apply output limits. Runtime field descriptions, defaults and existing docstrings remain unchanged.
src/agent_runtime/monitors/store.py Python A Select the live RAM monitor repository when a Controller hub owns the path, otherwise provide the standalone SQLite implementation. AgentMonitorStore records definitions, clipped observations, trigger receipts, revision-checked edits and lifetime judge-call reservations under version-2 storage rules. Shared helpers encode metadata and normalize recovery values; creation prunes settled monitor history while preserving open records. Explicit deletion removes child histories, whereas standalone retention only explicitly deletes monitor rows. Workers, model calls and checkpoint scheduling belong to separate owners.
src/agent_runtime/native/init.py Python A Model-led tool calling over smTO's execution and session services.
src/agent_runtime/native/activities.py Python A Execute foreground activity batches while preserving admission and receipt ownership.
src/agent_runtime/native/activity_effects.py Python A Additional proof needed for concurrency, beyond ordinary permission heuristics.

src/agent_runtime/native/activity_supervision_policy.py Python A Immutable acceptance-time policy for physical Activity observation, never inference.
src/agent_runtime/native/activity_watchdog.py Python A Observe completion and health through one bounded application worker.
src/agent_runtime/native/agent_turns.py Python A Own admission and cancellation for actual model computation. Lease contexts bind cancellable socket owners, release capacity on success or failure, and retain aggregate wait/active metrics. model_call bridges scheduled tracing clients, managed endpoint changes and Main fallback without duplicating permits. Run progression, logical call budgets and external job/resource claims keep separate owners.
src/agent_runtime/native/attachment_access.py Python A Resolve authorized task attachments and verify their original bytes before explicit reads. descriptor/manifest expose bounded metadata and reader hints; resolve checks task lineage, live grants and archive parents; verified_bytes and decode_text enforce integrity and supported encodings. src/agent_runtime/native/attachment_ingestion.py Python A Stream immutable attachments and publish task membership with the source grant.

Gateway PDF/Office schemas remain path based, uploads remain immutable, and missing transfer support produces a locality error instead of a controller parser fallback.
src/agent_runtime/native/attachment_transfer.py Python A Receive a pinned Gateway source into conversation-owned attachment storage.
src/agent_runtime/native/attachments.py Python A Store attachment bytes once under generated context identities, with RAM/standalone metadata and explicit conversation grants. Current Unicode-policy reads live in context_reads and do not use the internal byte reader.
src/agent_runtime/native/attention_episode.py Python A Durable, bounded recovery of an interrupted machine wait.
src/agent_runtime/native/authority_control.py Python A Own deterministic user-authority checkpoints across native execution domains.
src/agent_runtime/native/background.py Python A Connect Activity execution to long-lived jobs, exact receipts, human input and resumable task progress. Registration retains target identity; promotion observes the same job; reconciliation publishes completion through a durable mailbox. Input resumes correlate each attempt and preserve earlier receipts. Completion gates wait for required work and unresolved questions; recovery retains unknown effects and asks the resource owner to evaluate physical release rather than relaunching interrupted work.
src/agent_runtime/native/background_policy.py Python A Independent, captured policy for managed background Activities.
src/agent_runtime/native/budget_growth.py Python A Reserve bounded generation-budget increases per conversation.
src/agent_runtime/native/cancellation.py Python A Own native Stop authority and operation cancellation across RAM and standalone SQL stores. src/agent_runtime/native/capability_activation.py Python A Deterministic discovery admission, beneath immutable accepted authority.
src/agent_runtime/native/capability_grants.py Python A Human-owned grant decisions. No model calls or natural-language inference.
src/agent_runtime/native/capability_selection.py Python A Select an initial working tool surface within accepted capability authority. Catalog rebinding restores saved selection, current availability and memory projections; cancelled, stale or failed publications cannot authorize business tools. Interrupted selector attempts fall back within the frozen ceiling rather than silently consuming another model call.
src/agent_runtime/native/capability_surface.py Python A Remove excluded capability names from runtime-authored guidance.
src/agent_runtime/native/capability_trace.py Python A Transactional capability event outbox; trace delivery is replay safe.
src/agent_runtime/native/capsules.py Python A Deterministic, disposable turn metadata; the native journal is authoritative.
src/agent_runtime/native/carry_forward.py Python A Select bounded conversation history without altering execution evidence.
src/agent_runtime/native/catalog.py Python A Expose available controls and skill schemas within each accepted capability scope.
src/agent_runtime/native/clarification_options.py Python A Validate structured choices attached to ordinary questions.
src/agent_runtime/native/code_history.py Python A Read-only, thread-scoped Code discussions and accepted project rules. No inference.

src/agent_runtime/native/completion_recovery.py Python A Recover a contended Controller publication after an operation has already been accepted. Read the existing job/launch evidence, retain its identity, attach bounded recovery facts and wake the existing activity watchdog to observe completion. Repeated contention while saving metadata is tolerated because durable intent remains the recovery owner; no replacement command is submitted here.
src/agent_runtime/native/completion_report.py Python A Capture caller-owned final-response delivery policy and derive factual completion-report metadata. The report function excludes internal/self-asserted and carried-forward operations from its current-work counts and includes no tool bodies. Output-contract and publication owners consume these facts; this module neither creates fallback prose nor calls a model.
src/agent_runtime/native/consumer_projection.py Python A Apply optional source-owned redaction at model, public-state and structured-receipt boundaries. Preserve execution/control identities, normalize historical guidance and keep stored evidence separate from consumer-visible copies.
src/agent_runtime/native/context.py Python A Structural working context; exact history remains in the durable transcript.
src/agent_runtime/native/context_efficient_execution.py Python A Task-owned switch for canonical execution guidance; no tool/result policy.
src/agent_runtime/native/context_read_policy.py Python A Resolve and validate attached-Context policy from global, conversation and prompt settings, capture accepted snapshots, and synchronize explicit run revisions. src/agent_runtime/native/context_reads.py Python A Read scoped attached text with byte cursors and Unicode character allowances, then measure exact candidate pages against the model request budget without generation. src/agent_runtime/native/context_reset.py Python A Recover context capacity by changing the model view, never execution history.

src/agent_runtime/native/continuity.py Python A Small continuation facts over existing state; no inference or external reads.
src/agent_runtime/native/controls.py Python A Dispatch source-owned loop controls without a second decision owner.
src/agent_runtime/native/convergence.py Python A A bounded completion handshake, separate from task work progress.

src/agent_runtime/native/conversation_resources.py Python A Own volatile resource cleanup at the committed conversation deletion boundary.

src/agent_runtime/native/file_observations.py Python A Page recognized retained Files collections using exact canonical JSON character offsets and whole-record boundaries when possible. src/agent_runtime/native/final_response.py Python A Separate retained user-facing text from acceptance of terminal completion.
