Cancellation and retries retain identity, while the API coordinator owns capacity, projection repair and execution wakeup.
src/agent_runtime/native/gateway_admission.py Python A Keep an unavailable selected Gateway from occupying an Activity execution slot. available starts or polls one bounded health probe per target, reject builds the definitely-unstarted receipt, and finish_unavailable_batch settles wholly offline work without another model call. The run owner serializes these in-memory checks; the registry owns network health observation and the Activity scheduler owns receipt persistence, dependency blocking and actual dispatch. A late probe cannot reverse a retained failure or establish the outcome of an earlier claim.
src/agent_runtime/native/gateway_scope.py Python A Reconstruct immutable run selection and verify every saved Gateway identity.
src/agent_runtime/native/generate_prose.py Python A Task-owned presentation preference. Never part of a provider request or authority.
src/agent_runtime/native/generation_controls.py Python A Collect live repetition limits, the force-budget switch and role-owned recovery controls at each model-decision boundary. Accepted task/run context supplies thinking and legacy fallback; this projection does not update settings, mutate a running response or start a model call.
src/agent_runtime/native/generation_recovery.py Python A Generation rejection bookkeeping inside the existing one-recovery decision loop.
src/agent_runtime/native/goal_echo.py Python A Legacy setting compatibility; epoch intent is mandatory in shared context assembly.
src/agent_runtime/native/guard_strikes.py Python A Policy strikes and deterministic continuation using the ordinary dispatch path.
src/agent_runtime/native/guidance_compact.py Python A Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.
src/agent_runtime/native/handoff_safety.py Python A Project explicitly selected historical payloads by omitting internal reasoning/control fields, live handles and oversized/deep text. These helpers retain ordinary literal text and do not implement credential-value redaction, despite compatibility secrets arguments. Contract extraction selects public fields without accepting a compiler result.
src/agent_runtime/native/history.py Python A Durable conversation continuation without replaying prior invocations.
src/agent_runtime/native/host.py Python A Explicit service owner for the one conversation runtime.
src/agent_runtime/native/http_connections.py Python A Own provisional and established literal HTTP recipes for a single run, Gateway and origin. Capture/deduplicate bounded references, resolve exact authority and project only executable choices into copied tool schemas. Session invalidation belongs to http_session_state; these records neither grant cross-run access nor open destination sockets.
src/agent_runtime/native/http_oauth.py Python A Remove recognized OAuth callback query strings from log records before ordinary optional LOGS redaction. Handle both formatted messages and logging argument containers while preserving Uvicorn access-format shape where possible. Installation attaches the filter once to the known HTTP/access loggers; this module does not receive callbacks or manage tokens.
src/agent_runtime/native/http_reuse.py Python A Guide Conversation HTTP reuse through bounded deterministic corrections before dispatch. Verified setup and current run-owned references constrain copied tool schemas; explicit alternate configuration and higher-priority routing retain their normal validation. The module records rejected operations for crash recovery, never synthesizes an HTTP operation or performs inference itself.
src/agent_runtime/native/http_session_state.py Python A Own volatile run/conversation HTTP authentication scopes, recipe registry lifetime, OAuth callback readiness and exact durable resume. Lock-protected metadata and best-effort Gateway invalidators coordinate cleanup; checkpoints retain only the continuation while callback/code state remains process-local. Literal credentials belong to connection recipes, not a separate input vault.
src/agent_runtime/native/human_input.py Python A Commit replies against their current native interaction checkpoint.
src/agent_runtime/native/inference_options.py Python A Adapt already-selected deterministic tool focus to provider keyword support. Signature inspection enables required-tool mode only where accepted; the HTTP reuse owner validates the final tool projection. No provider request, retry or change to the canonical capability catalog occurs here.
src/agent_runtime/native/input_guards.py Python A Capability-owned deterministic input rejection before journal persistence.
src/agent_runtime/native/input_resources.py Python A Capture resources with one accepted user instruction and apply them at its safe processing boundary. Retry receipts preserve parameter values and selected target identities; application rechecks context grants/digests and Gateway pins, validates merged budgets, rebuilds catalog/context and preserves the primary target. Public projections expose labels and keys rather than private parameter records.
src/agent_runtime/native/job_control_validation.py Python A Job-control semantics required even when optional schema checks are disabled.
src/agent_runtime/native/job_detachment.py Python A Detach managed-job completion requirements without changing process truth.
src/agent_runtime/native/job_handoff.py Python A Consume prompt-scoped wake signals; the Gateway owns deadlines and input.
src/agent_runtime/native/job_waits.py Python A Wait for changes across jobs using existing observation and continuation owners.
src/agent_runtime/native/jobs.py Python A Own scoped managed-job controls and durable wait registration. Inspectors reconcile captured Gateway facts, retain exact terminal results and distinguish management success, output availability, process outcome and unknown control. Wait predicates read retained state; an owned resume revalidates selected evidence before clearing its checkpoint. TTY input uses runtime delivery identities, human waits keep precedence and no job control may silently replay an uncertain effect.
src/agent_runtime/native/learned_mappings.py Python A Apply approved mapping definitions at native tool admission boundaries. The model still chooses each proposed tool call. Preparation filters rules using the accepted task generation, scope, source identities, structural match and workflow dependencies, then pins resolved arguments, source revisions and private environment for the accepted invocation. Selection claims prevent a one-time choice from authorizing two required retries. Outcome observation records execution separately from user assessment; helpers return calls/rejections and never dispatch.
src/agent_runtime/native/live_budget.py Python A Collect content-free thinking notices without mutating state from a worker.
src/agent_runtime/native/loop.py Python A Own the model decision cycle over durable run state and verified execution results.
src/agent_runtime/native/memory_authority.py Python A Bridge process-local unsafe consent to RAM control-state publication. accept_unsafe correlates the exact run or Activity checkpoint, publishes its accepted decision or input wake, then marks the checked volatile grant while still holding the shared authorization lock. This ordering prevents transaction retries or rollback from accepting twice. It performs no transport work, and saved presentation state cannot recreate a grant after restart.
src/agent_runtime/native/memory_cancellation.py Python A Implement Stop and graceful terminalization as atomic Controller RAM state publications. stop reconciles retained invocation truth, revokes competing wakes/admission and saves cancellation authority before dispatching cleanup callbacks. finish_grace releases the final owner; the indexed native continuation worker handles grace deadlines. Publication is to the active hub, with disk recovery owned by its separate checkpoint lifecycle.
src/agent_runtime/native/memory_continuation_worker.py Python A Drive explicitly ready native runs through bounded continuation workers. The scheduler consumes RAM readiness indexes, reconciles retained physical work, honors Stop/Pause/capacity and calls the normal resume owner; condition notifications and deadlines avoid polling all saved history.
src/agent_runtime/native/memory_pause.py Python A Implement Pause, Resume and model-decision acceptance for the Controller RAM repository. Detached drafts and in-place restoration preserve references held by the running loop while optimistic transactions retry. Budget checks and decision callbacks execute once outside retryable publication; Stop/Pause and generation fences are rechecked inside it. Observations publish only after success and failed drafts leave the active checkpoint unchanged.
src/agent_runtime/native/memory_retention.py Python A Atomic RAM retention with evidence fences and post-commit file removal.
src/agent_runtime/native/memory_scheduler.py Python A Own indexed resource admission in the default Controller RAM store. MemoryScheduler persists accepted profiles and pending access descriptions, evaluates capacity/conflict/fairness rules under one transaction root, and publishes queue transitions with lock-state updates. Configuration and successful ownership changes wake existing waiters; observation_context reads one coherent snapshot. Exclusive bootstrap and operation_settlement reconcile retained physical ownership from evidence, so an uncertain remote job is never released merely because the Controller restarted. The base Scheduler supplies shared calculations; no model, remote probe or workload runs here.
src/agent_runtime/native/metrics.py Python A Numeric run diagnostics accumulated from the existing bounded native event stream.
src/agent_runtime/native/model_decision.py Python A Acquire and validate the next decision under the run's inference reservation.
src/agent_runtime/native/observation_capacity.py Python A Reserve bounded observation, completion and control capacity outside workload slots.
src/agent_runtime/native/observation_diagnostics.py Python A Numeric observation evidence in trace details, never in model context.
src/agent_runtime/native/observation_schedule.py Python A Define independent completion and health observation deadlines.
src/agent_runtime/native/observations.py Python A Build structured receipt observations and execution/recovery facts for journal and runtime consumers. Optional source redaction and availability enrichment preserve stored evidence; the final model-only text allowance belongs to result_text, rather than this structured observation stage.
src/agent_runtime/native/opening_plan.py Python A Publish an optional first-decision overview without requiring one for execution.
src/agent_runtime/native/operation_receipts.py Python A Publish dispatcher closure and proven no-start receipts at native execution boundaries.
src/agent_runtime/native/operations.py Python A Coordinate authorized tool dispatch, cancellation and durable operation evidence.
src/agent_runtime/native/outcome_reporting.py Python A Allow an accepted diagnostic-report obligation to cite a settled process outcome without claiming a successful effect. Exact unique requirement IDs, answered status, required prose, scoped receipts and complete sequence membership constrain this role. Mixed effect obligations cannot use the reporting shortcut. Candidate selection and correction reuse existing evidence, while completion.py retains aggregate verification and terminal publication stays with the control owner.
src/agent_runtime/native/outcomes.py Python A Execution facts survive control, context and presentation failures.
src/agent_runtime/native/output_contract.py Python A Resolved task output intent, frozen before execution and enforced at completion.
src/agent_runtime/native/output_previews.py Python A Describe retained execution excerpts and construct concrete recovery calls over existing receipts and job logs. Helpers keep source loss distinct from presentation clipping, reserve wording space and attach source identity/byte-range metadata; they never recover uncaptured bytes or execute the original command.
src/agent_runtime/native/parallel_policy.py Python A Resolve scoped foreground overlap policy and preserve accepted run snapshots.
src/agent_runtime/native/parallel_tools.py Python A Project Shell/Python batch schemas over ordinary Activity tools.
src/agent_runtime/native/parameter_binding.py Python A Translate symbolic invoke_bound calls into validated dispatch copies before Activity admission. Dynamic declarations appear only for accepted bound parameters; expansion preserves the original call, captures revision provenance and blocks changes to runtime routing or unadvertised child tools. Composite schemas are checked even when ordinary optional schema guards are disabled. This module prepares inputs; normal execution, permission, target and receipt owners still dispatch the work.
src/agent_runtime/native/parameter_reads.py Python A Dispatch accepted parameter value/structure/field reads and admit complete field pages into model context. The shared binding reader owns pointer validity and projection; capacity checks construct the candidate conversation, include current tools and reserve execution tokens. An oversized page returns a smaller explicit recovery action, or a terminal capacity explanation at one entry, without truncating fields or starting tool execution.
src/agent_runtime/native/pause.py Python A Serialize cooperative Pause, Resume and decision acceptance with native ownership.
src/agent_runtime/native/prerequisites.py Python A Bounded structured blockers; no interpretation of program output or user intent.
src/agent_runtime/native/presentation.py Python A Project native tool data after publication's redaction policy into structured result sections. result_sections hides credential-control receipts, bounds top-level previews and adapts native Gmail envelopes before deterministic normalization. Each section retains its receipt reference, with raw access disabled. This adapter does not modify saved results or rerun tools; publication owns redaction and handles conversion failures.
src/agent_runtime/native/progress.py Python A Operation identity and observed state versions, independent of prose/IDs.
src/agent_runtime/native/progress_narration.py Python A Project one decision's ordinary content; never mutate model history or execution.
src/agent_runtime/native/projection.py Python A Structural model projection; never edits native messages or execution evidence.
src/agent_runtime/native/projection_selection.py Python A Disposable history selections belong to one journal projection window.
src/agent_runtime/native/proposed_plan.py Python A Validate canonical Plan artifacts and their source identities.
src/agent_runtime/native/protocol.py Python A Provide the native control protocol, prompt accessors and JSON serialization helpers.
src/agent_runtime/native/publication.py Python A Project durable outcomes and results into API/UI display documents.
src/agent_runtime/native/python_entrypoint_correction.py Python A Task-owned Python source correction preference; independent of Agent Checks.
src/agent_runtime/native/python_source_canonicalization.py Python A Normalize Python entrypoint shapes without executing submitted code.
src/agent_runtime/native/quality_recovery.py Python A Durable single recovery for generation quality, independent of protocol retries.
src/agent_runtime/native/ramble_guard.py Python A Task-owned switch for convergence guidance at the end of agent instructions.
src/agent_runtime/native/reasoning_budget.py Python A Run-owned percentage for prompt guidance, independent of provider parameters.
src/agent_runtime/native/receipt_truth.py Python A Read a claimed invocation in the caller's control transaction.
src/agent_runtime/native/recovery.py Python A Bound native completion and user-input control corrections without replaying work.
src/agent_runtime/native/redaction.py Python A Compatibility imports; all algorithms belong to agent_runtime.redaction.
src/agent_runtime/native/redaction_policy.py Python A Bind accepted redaction settings before new or resumed native ingress is projected. Resolve existing run identity through RunStore and keep its saved policy; new work captures the UI settings namespace. Missing policy on a loaded current run fails rather than silently taking new defaults. These helpers update request context, not stored settings or raw evidence. See also: src/agent_runtime/redaction.py
src/agent_runtime/native/removable_destinations.py Python A Resolve removable destination intent before native writes and resume the existing wait.
src/agent_runtime/native/request_fragments.py Python A Reuse bounded instruction fragments within one live run owner.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_access.py Python A Bind task resource consent to frozen identities and the native authority lifecycle.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_adapters/init.py Python A Working Context adapters for resources without a first-class skill.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_adapters/git.py Python A Retain conversation-owned Git repository setup from private Gateway receipts. discovery and prepare derive bounded observation plans; validate checks native paths, Gateway identity and remote manifests; after_result publishes or stales records through WorkingContext. project exposes reusable setup without branch/status claims, while supersedes preserves replaced repository identities. The adapter launches no helper process or inference and grants no permission; sealed catalog text remains the runtime guidance owner.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_adapters/guidance_compact.py Python A Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_adapters/kubernetes.py Python A Retain verified Kubernetes setup for conversation continuity without retaining cluster objects or authentication. prepare binds parsed selectors and known records to one Gateway; after_result validates the private receipt and actual execution outcome before publication. validate, project, supersedes and check_target enforce record, route and namespace identity boundaries. WorkingContext owns state/events and the Gateway owns configuration reads; no adapter probe, auth plugin or helper model is invoked.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_adapters/slurm.py Python A Retain conversation-owned SLURM cluster setup from bounded Gateway observations. prepare excludes job/privileged/interactive paths, after_result checks target and execution truth, and projection exposes only cluster/Gateway hints. Validation and replacement rules preserve exact configuration identities and independent routes. Structural observation faults enter the existing runtime circuit breaker; ordinary missing setup cannot retry or alter scheduler work. This module owns no queue cache, scheduler credential or connection.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_adapters/ssh.py Python A Connect captured Shell execution to conversation-owned SSH identity records. prepare carries matching host pins, including stale ones, and binds an unambiguous target for remote privilege; after_result publishes verified receipts or stales identity/authentication failures. validate, project and supersedes separate retained keys from public endpoint hints. This adapter keeps no live session, grants no authority and never silently replaces a changed host key or retries a command.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_admission.py Python A Open resource consent before accepting any effects in a model decision.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_context_assets.py Python A Associate up to four typed documentation references with a verified conversation resource, using existing eligible ContextStore grants and the resource revision. Normalize exact metadata, project stale/missing/active status and expose only active IDs to read_context; association replacement never owns or deletes document bytes.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_locks.py Python A Store standalone accepted scheduling profiles and their read/write/exclusive/observation access rows. Queue triggers keep lock state and timestamps in the same transaction as admission or settlement. The shared blocker calculation compares only concrete overlapping resources between participating families; pending entries reserve nothing and observation-only work does not lock the observed workload.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_metadata.py Python A Bounded, read-only metadata projections over the existing resource stores.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_policy.py Python A Resolve scoped resource-aware admission policy and preserve accepted run snapshots.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_recovery.py Python A Resolve native resource interventions and continue exact never-executed candidates.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_scheduler.py Python A Coordinate ready Activity admission, concrete-resource conflicts and shared capacity before ordinary execution. Scheduler selects MemoryScheduler in the default Controller RAM authority; the SQLite table contract below describes the standalone backend. Accepted profiles and current participation policy determine admission, while operation_settlement owns physical release. Wait observations and aggregate timing remain diagnostic; neither a capacity reservation nor a successful-looking result grants permission or proves a process ended.
src/agent_runtime/native/resource_wait_graph.py Python A Explain bounded resource waits without changing execution ownership.
src/agent_runtime/native/result_availability.py Python A Resolve current execution readiness from owned job/activity rows and recorded receipt links, then preserve those facts in model observations. Pending, blocked, unavailable and ready describe access to final evidence; execution success and output-page completeness remain separate. This module performs retained reads only and never polls, reruns or rewrites the source operation.
src/agent_runtime/native/result_recovery.py Python A Page captured execution receipts and direct recovery without repeating execution.
src/agent_runtime/native/result_text.py Python A Render automatic tool output as model-only text with live head/tail limits, source-specific redaction and explicit recovery. Acquire authorized retained receipt/job-log ranges once per preparation, preserve requested pages and images, and report capacity shortening separately from missing source coverage.
src/agent_runtime/native/result_waits.py Python A Persist subscriptions for read_result calls accepted before final evidence exists. Registration retains original arguments and call identity; canonical run progression delivers one correlated update, handles explicit detach/interruption, and blocks finish until the model consumes outstanding pages. Existing supervision wakes the run; this module owns no worker or model loop.
src/agent_runtime/native/retention.py Python A Explicit retention boundaries; active or uncertain effects retain their evidence.
src/agent_runtime/native/run_continuation.py Python A Create linear continuation/restart attempts from retained native checkpoints without inference or replay. Explicit field allowlists carry task truth, policy, notebook scope and artifact access; attempt counters and temporary credentials are reset. Shared transactions fence child identity, accepted follow-up amendments and grant resolution, while inherited uncertain effects remain subject to mutation checks.
src/agent_runtime/native/run_lifecycle.py Python A Prepare owned native resumes and reasoning turns from durable execution truth.
src/agent_runtime/native/run_restart.py Python A Fresh execution state for a stopped task, retaining its accepted configuration.
src/agent_runtime/native/runtime_facts.py Python A Bounded runtime notices, projected as facts instead of conversation turns.
src/agent_runtime/native/scheduler_wake.py Python A In-process invalidations for durable scheduler state; SQLite remains authoritative.
src/agent_runtime/native/scheduling_profile.py Python A Build immutable per-operation scheduling evidence so admission can compare resource demand and conflicts without another model decision. ResourceAccess, OperationBinding and SchedulingProfileV2 retain validated identities, certainty, lifecycle and deterministic digests; profile_for_activity reconciles structural inference, hints and exact user assertions. revise_contract produces a candidate revision while the API/store owner fences dispatch and persistence. Local classification and bounded content hashing may read files; no workload is launched and no execution permission is granted.
src/agent_runtime/native/schema_correction.py Python A Normalize schema-declared JSON containers and registered argument representations.
src/agent_runtime/native/selection_context.py Python A Revision-bound, effect-free reads of accepted selector input within its call budget.
src/agent_runtime/native/shell_sequence.py Python A Ordered ordinary Shell dispatch, without intermediate inference or a step-count cap.
src/agent_runtime/native/shell_source_canonicalization.py Python A Deterministic closure of one unfinished literal Shell argument.
src/agent_runtime/native/snapshot.py Python A Enforce the accepted policy and inference envelope required by current checkpoints.
src/agent_runtime/native/state.py Python A Initialize, restore and checkpoint the accepted native run state.
src/agent_runtime/native/status.py Python A User Task status projected from existing native and transport state.
src/agent_runtime/native/steering_context.py Python A Retain completed or interrupted responses as inert continuation context.
src/agent_runtime/native/stop_confirmation.py Python A Finite, durable observation episodes; an exhausted budget never proves process exit.
src/agent_runtime/native/stop_policy.py Python A Define and resolve the Stop preference captured when a task is accepted. StopPolicy validates instant/graceful mode and the bounded grace timeout; resolve selects prompt, conversation, global or default settings with source attribution. This module reads settings and returns normalized data; cancellation.py applies it without modifying the public schema.
src/agent_runtime/native/stop_summary.py Python A Bounded, generation-fenced epoch handoffs while ordinary execution is revoked.
src/agent_runtime/native/stop_summary_model.py Python A One explicit summary result using the accepted model and retained task evidence.
src/agent_runtime/native/summaries.py Python A Build retrospective task metadata from accepted output and recorded facts.
src/agent_runtime/native/supervision_presentation.py Python A Shared runtime status copy for desktop/mobile projection and durable transitions.
src/agent_runtime/native/target_identity.py Python A Capture Controller-owned execution identity and optional physical topology for scheduling. Validated enrollments bind registry IDs to pinned TLS identity; offline physical evidence merges aliases and cannot change beneath unresolved captured claims. Conversation and transfer helpers bind concrete resources to selected targets, while admission revalidates trust and topology. Missing topology does not create a global lock; missing required routing identity prevents dispatch.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_advance.py Python A Explicit queue release keeps a stalled attempt's execution outcome intact.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_board.py Python A Model-authored strategy, separate from immutable user/caller obligations.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract.py Python A Compile accepted user-request revisions through native or queued session ownership.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_attempts.py Python A Retain compiler attempt identities, bounded public output and rejection evidence so failed generation can be inspected and explicitly retried without inventing a new task. Source digests and atomic Stop/amendment/tombstone checks fence retry admission; the compiler/session owns transport and persistence, while activity projection consumes these records.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_fields.py Python A Read tolerant bookkeeping views without rewriting accepted compiler output.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_integrity.py Python A Compare generated parameter references and high-risk scope paths with explicit current compiler source before a contract is installed. Bounded syntactic scans return violations and completeness metadata for attempt diagnostics; they perform no I/O, expansion, broad schema validation or execution authorization. The compiler uses the captured guard mode to decide whether to check.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_integrity_settings.py Python A Resolve the integrity guard's new-request override/global default and bind an existing run's exact saved choice into active context. Keeping this switch separate from compiler budgets lets admission freeze the guard without altering generation policy; incomplete current snapshots fail.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_models.py Python A Define compiler generation schemas and optional offline contract diagnostics.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_policy.py Python A Validate coupled compiler output, recovery and thinking settings, derive each attempt's token allowance, and capture immutable policy for admission/resume. Settings updates reserve required output headroom; current saved runs must supply complete policy rather than silently adopting newer defaults. This module computes policy and leaves persistence and transport to callers.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_projection.py Python A Project accepted task intent to the executor while retaining the human journal.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_session.py Python A Connect the shared compiler/selector and preview publisher to an owned native run. Save, event, pause, cancellation and source-generation adapters preserve normal lifecycle rules; acceptance stages one RAM transaction or an existing SQL writer transaction before compiler output becomes durable. This module does not define the model prompt or task-contract schema.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_snapshot.py Python A Export, validate and install allowlisted compiler outcomes for same-task retry and queued preparation. Copy intent, provenance, saved policy and phase accounting while excluding arbitrary execution state. Import checks size, revision consistency and selected capability ceilings before restoring accepted, clarification or failed outcomes under the caller's run ownership.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_stream.py Python A Turn incomplete contract tool arguments into safe, bounded activity previews while inference is running. A display-only parser withholds incomplete scalar values; a locked publisher throttles changed checkpoints and fences late callbacks after cancellation, supersession or close. The final compiler acceptance path independently validates complete output.
src/agent_runtime/native/task_state.py Python A Project deterministic run facts and current control guidance into model context.
src/agent_runtime/native/temporal_routing.py Python A Conservative user-intent boundary; the existing scheduler still owns timing/execution.
src/agent_runtime/native/terminal_normalization.py Python A Validate text-only final-response intent through ordinary completion authority.
src/agent_runtime/native/thinking_history.py Python A Private accepted reasoning. Canonical messages and history selection stay unchanged.
src/agent_runtime/native/token_throughput.py Python A Time-weighted throughput for calls with provider token counts and matching timings.
src/agent_runtime/native/tool_result_preview.py Python A Define the single live global policy for automatic tool-output text at model preparation. Validate head/tail Unicode character counts, hide retired delivery keys in saved preference reads and reject new writes to those retired controls; task snapshots do not own this presentation policy.
src/agent_runtime/native/transfer_recovery.py Python A Reconcile accepted Gateway transfers before ordinary Activity recovery or retry.
src/agent_runtime/native/transport_recovery.py Python A Durable connection-only retries; model response policy never controls transport faults.
src/agent_runtime/native/turn_dispatch.py Python A Turn a complete accepted model proposal into direct-control or shared Activity dispatch. The module separates metadata normalization, generation-fenced acceptance, exact call claims, receipt reuse, guarded invocation and result incorporation. It rejects mixed human-interaction decisions before effects and preserves unknown outcomes rather than replaying them. Native state owns accepted identity and evidence; ExecutionEngine and domain adapters own concrete effects. Temporary parameter/timing context is restored on exit, and late results cannot by themselves resume a cancelled run.
src/agent_runtime/native/turn_results.py Python A Receipt incorporation, convergence and terminal conversation transitions.
src/agent_runtime/native/unknowns.py Python A Track uncertain operation provenance and keep replay/completion decisions conservative.
src/agent_runtime/native/unsafe_actions.py Python A Bind typed unsafe approvals to concrete invocations within the existing run wait lifecycle.
src/agent_runtime/native/wait_control.py Python A User adjustments to an existing timed wait, fenced by its owner and revision.
src/agent_runtime/native/wall_budget.py Python A Configured attempt durations, distinct from absolute deadlines.
src/agent_runtime/observability/init.py Python A Expose request-scoped events, safe sinks and Agent trace types.
src/agent_runtime/observability/activity_page.py Python A Turn retained trace windows into readable Activity pages without hydrating full traces. activity_page obtains cursor context and timing; project_page applies shared redaction, optional cumulative-progress grouping and byte-aware preview compaction. Command identity and inspector links survive shortened detail. Exact mode preserves event selection, not unbounded payload text. These helpers read retained state and never execute commands or alter permission.
src/agent_runtime/observability/agent_trace.py Python A Maintain request traces, activity details and timing views for the Agent UI.
src/agent_runtime/observability/async_notifications.py Python A Wake asynchronous observers from existing synchronous state writers without allocating polling threads. AgentTraceStore and AgentUiUpdateBroker consume this primitive; it stores no user-facing notification records and performs no delivery.
src/agent_runtime/observability/capability_presentation.py Python A Project capability activity labels without conferring execution authority.
src/agent_runtime/observability/completion_report.py Python A Provide deterministic user-visible receipts when a terminal task lacks an appropriate agent answer. record tracks the delivery policy and resumption epoch in response_metrics and calls the display-message writer with a stable identity. It honors explicit silence, normal answers and waiting states, preserves uncertainty, and does not backfill historical requests or call a model. The caller owns persistence with the terminal event.
src/agent_runtime/observability/content_policy.py Python A Exclude device, browser and provider payloads from diagnostics and portable history.
src/agent_runtime/observability/context.py Python A Gate, sanitize and fan out request-scoped observability events.
src/agent_runtime/observability/conversation_delivery.py Python A Preserve explicitly published chat fields when private tool diagnostics are reduced to metadata. conversation_event starts with content_policy.diagnostic_event, restores only allowlisted scalar fields for user/assistant messages, progress and marked answer streams, and retains explicit final_response text. It returns a copied event for trace or sink delivery; surrounding projection applies credential policy. Tool bodies, raw provider output and arbitrary event prose cannot become chat through this helper.
src/agent_runtime/observability/conversation_history.py Python A Recover missing historical clarification and steering messages for display from accepted native receipts, journal exchanges and amendments. The helper uses the registered RAM owner or an existing read-only SQLite file, matches waits to actual ask_user receipts and labels inferred timestamps. It returns an enriched copy only when needed, skips private diagnostic traces and tolerates unavailable legacy SQL data. It neither updates the journal nor resumes a run.
src/agent_runtime/observability/display_messages.py Python A Maintain durable display messages independently of model acceptance and execution state. record consumes explicitly published message/stream events under the trace writer lock, increments revisions, deduplicates sequence fragments and preserves interrupted drafts when a later answer supersedes them. It attaches detached changes to the event and stores the current projection in response_metrics before persistence/broadcast. Completion-report publication shares this writer; arbitrary tool text and forged display revisions are not accepted.
src/agent_runtime/observability/events.py Python A Define the structured pipeline event envelope and lifecycle names.
src/agent_runtime/observability/execution_activity.py Python A Supply compact operation context and current thinking/wait labels for refresh without restoring full trace bodies. Helpers prefer current in-memory traces and use narrow journal lookups after eviction. They join command starts, invocation/file context and transfer/output timestamps, project redaction before shortening, and distinguish actual terminal evidence from detached or unresolved work. Parsing a command for named files never executes it or proves a filesystem effect.
src/agent_runtime/observability/execution_context.py Python A Extract bounded file context from already-public tool evidence. file_context distinguishes requested paths, observed results, revision-backed writes, transfers and collected artifacts; shell_files conservatively labels static paths named in understood commands. Both omit file contents and retain at most 20 entries, with truncation metadata where available. Upstream projection owns credential filtering; this module never opens paths, evaluates shell expressions or changes execution state.
src/agent_runtime/observability/latency.py Python A Attribute local inference work without changing execution or authority.
src/agent_runtime/observability/memory_model_output.py Python A Store diagnostic provider output in immutable RAM pages under the controller state hub, with standalone memory mode for fixtures. Checkpoint adapters load/write SQL representations; request tombstones, retention transactions and process-local notifications protect late publication and reader isolation.
src/agent_runtime/observability/memory_trace_journal.py Python A Own live trace headers, immutable event pages, lookup indexes, deletion tombstones and the event sequence in the Controller state hub. Recovery/checkpoint callbacks translate the SQLite representation; runtime methods reject direct SQL and return detached projections. AgentTraceStore supplies already-projected events and coordinates IDs, while retention hooks join writes in the same transaction. Paging and restoration do not authorize execution or reconstruct missing receipts.
src/agent_runtime/observability/message_timestamps.py Python A Reduce server events into user-send, assistant-start and finished-reply clocks.
src/agent_runtime/observability/model_output.py Python A Select the authoritative RAM capture repository for controller-owned or in-memory use, with a standalone SQLite compatibility implementation for unowned paths. Request/call identity, paged reads and terminal metadata keep diagnostics separate from normal trace/history consumers.
src/agent_runtime/observability/openwebui_format.py Python A Render sanitized pipeline events as readable Open WebUI Markdown.
src/agent_runtime/observability/operation_preview.py Python A Build bounded operation labels under the selected optional redaction policy.
src/agent_runtime/observability/projection.py Python A Prepare bounded diagnostic views while keeping runtime evidence under its original owner. Event and trace helpers select optional credential policy, enforce separate display/debug limits, preserve declared telemetry identities and apply mandatory public-error projection. Returned event/payload copies serve sinks and API readers; they are not execution receipts. See also: src/agent_runtime/redaction.py
src/agent_runtime/observability/redaction.py Python A Compatibility exports for bounded observability projections.
src/agent_runtime/observability/response_timing.py Python A Attribute response wall time from recorded execution spans.
src/agent_runtime/observability/response_tokens.py Python A Account cumulative per-call token usage without depending on task completion.
src/agent_runtime/observability/runtime_control_presentation.py Python A Read-only capability catalog entries for the Agent's runtime controls.
src/agent_runtime/observability/runtime_issue_evidence.py Python A Build deterministic runtime-error evidence from retained facts for one correlated operation and its explicitly linked parallel children. execution_evidence joins typed execution/exit facts, bounded Shell command previews and stderr/combined output, with mandatory error-catalog sanitization. Optional receipt/inspector readers must remain request-scoped and read-only. explanation describes counts, nonexecution or exit codes without guessing causes, calling a model or repairing work.
src/agent_runtime/observability/runtime_issues.py Python A Reduce typed runtime events into revisioned conversation notices. RuntimeIssue models retain owner/correlation, safe catalog copy, occurrence provenance and optional bounded execution evidence. transitions recognizes failures, retries and owner-confirmed recovery while preserving unknown effects; latest selects the newest published revision. AgentTraceStore owns publication and persistence. These notices neither retry operations nor grant permissions, and task completion alone cannot resolve a failed child.
src/agent_runtime/observability/shell_inspection.py Python A Project retained command evidence for ordinary conversation transport and explicit Shell inspection. Identity helpers scope events to an operation; compact transport omits Shell transcripts while a stateful projector preserves the existing Python viewer contract. command_capture derives display state from receipts, input/resource waits and actual output timestamps, keeping detached or unknown effects explicit. No process is started, polled, cancelled or authorized by these projections.
src/agent_runtime/observability/shell_job_inspection.py Python A Convert retained background Shell job and receipt facts into a browser capture snapshot. job_capture resolves terminal/nonexecution/unknown states, applies optional TRACES redaction before tail limits, suppresses purged output and exposes partial or unavailable capture explicitly. timestamp converts existing numeric epochs to UTC labels. The caller owns lookup and observation lifetime; this module performs no Gateway request, job mutation or model call.
src/agent_runtime/observability/sinks.py Python A Deliver already-sanitized pipeline events to memory, logs or formatted callbacks.
src/agent_runtime/observability/startup_timing.py Python A Derive an observational startup waterfall from supplied trace events. snapshot selects existing admission/phase facts, accumulates controller/model queue waits and computes intervals between first recorded milestones. Missing or invalid timestamp segments remain absent, reversed spans clamp to zero, and no provider prefill or execution authority is inferred. This reducer neither starts services nor writes state.
src/agent_runtime/observability/task_contract_activity.py Python A Expose retained compiler revisions through the existing activity inspector.
src/agent_runtime/observability/task_timing.py Python A Reduce trace-ingestion events into compact timing receipts for later task/request projections. record retains lifecycle states, operation/call/job identities and trustworthy timestamp boundaries, with separate repeated spans and unknown-coverage markers. It drops nested telemetry and never stores command bodies or replays the trace journal. The trace owner persists this state; the task projector unions concurrent intervals and decides wall-time categories. Missing boundaries and detached work stay explicit rather than becoming invented execution time.
src/agent_runtime/observability/tool_activity.py Python A Project bounded, redacted inspector sections for one native tool invocation.
src/agent_runtime/observability/trace_journal.py Python A Select Controller RAM trace storage or standalone SQLite compatibility storage.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/init.py Python A Deterministic presentation of actual tool results.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/display_document.py Python A Build structured client documents from already normalized result shapes and caller-validated display plans. DisplaySection and DisplayDocument retain source references, ordered rows, column hints, content and preview metadata; build_display_document resolves section sources and deduplicates aliases for implicit plans. Raw availability requires a caller-supplied permission flag, while actual download authorization remains elsewhere. Markdown fallback reconstructs simpler shapes and does not preserve every specialized display option.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/display_primitives.py Python A Describe the local presentation choices available for normalized tool results. DisplayPrimitiveManifest records accepted shapes/capabilities, renderer names and declarative parameter/safety hints; DisplayPrimitiveRegistry rejects duplicate IDs and resolves compatible choices. The default catalog covers email views, tables, text/code/JSON, scalar/error, debug raw payloads and composite output. Registration does not execute capabilities, and manifests do not themselves enforce access policy or preview limits.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/models.py Python A Define the plan and rendered-response contracts shared by output renderers. DisplayPlan describes presentation kind, source sections and optional policy hints; RenderedOutput binds the resulting text to its plan and delivery metadata. These Pydantic models reject extra top-level fields while leaving section dictionaries open. They neither authorize source access nor apply redaction/constraints; callers and concrete rendering paths own those decisions.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/redaction.py Python A Compatibility import for the canonical output projection.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/renderers.py Python A Render supplied semantic results and display plans as deterministic Markdown/text or structured client documents. Shape dispatch formats command output, tables, aggregates, file previews and email reports; renderer wrappers select text or DisplayDocument delivery. Source lookup and primitive errors propagate, and referenced data is not fetched here. Input projection owns authorization, redaction and most bounds: generic Markdown/JSON formatting neither escapes all syntax nor imposes universal content limits.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/result_shapes.py Python A Define semantic result types and the normalization entry point used by deterministic output rendering. Typed text, command, table, file, aggregate and email shapes retain source identity and display hints; normalize_execution_result resolves stored data or a preview and delegates to the ordered adapter registry. Models reject extra top-level fields but do not authorize raw access, enforce size limits or redact secrets. All data comes from supplied execution evidence rather than new tool or model work.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/shape_adapters.py Python A Convert existing execution payloads into semantic result shapes using ordered local rules. ShapeAdapter matches status, capability, payload keys and custom predicates; ShapeAdapterRegistry selects the first rule by priority and ID. Specialized email/capability projections precede generic rows, values, command output, JSON and text fallbacks. Callbacks copy display context and preserve available count hints, but do not execute actions, enforce consent or fetch provider data. Invalid coercions and callback failures propagate to the caller.
src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/table_export.py Python A Serialize supplied row dictionaries into CSV and optionally write a workspace export. table_columns preserves explicit or first-seen column order, rows_to_csv_text formats cells, and write_csv_artifact returns file metadata after writing UTF-8 bytes. Directory creation and writes are the only external effects; IO errors propagate. Export paths, privacy, spreadsheet interpretation and collisions are caller concerns, and this helper does not register an immutable artifact version.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/init.py Python A Local Agent Parameter Store subsystem.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding.py Python A Resolve task-owned accepted parameters into exact tool arguments and Shell/Python inputs. Source reads, structure/field pages and bounded correction actions share JSON Pointer rules; generic bindings reject conflicting destinations and preserve accepted revisions. This module performs no store lookup, model call, interpolation or execution. Callers validate the resolved tool schema and authorize the concrete arguments; optional model projections do not alter executor data.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding_approvals.py Python A Persist approval evidence and the generation boundary for newly accepted tasks. Equivalent reusable rules share an identity; a new rule advances the authority’s approval generation once. The rule, generation marker and approval receipt/history commit together in Controller RAM or standalone SQLite. Accepted task snapshots retain their earlier generation through edits and continuation. Idempotent retries must carry the same request hash; changed reviewed revisions fail as conflicts.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding_evidence.py Python A Normalize recorded binding provenance for one concrete invocation. Direct calls retain their recorded links. Supported composite calls strip the selected activity/step/item destination prefix, preserving sequence-wide cwd and timeout links where implemented. This adapter copies evidence and returns None when it cannot establish the requested concrete relationship; it never discovers bindings by comparing parameter values to tool arguments.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding_reviews.py Python A Review successful invocation evidence and save reusable bindings for future tasks. BindingReviews joins the selected run, exact settled receipt, accepted parameter snapshot and current tool contract. Public projections mask literals; stateless previews bind source choices to evidence and saved revisions. Explicit approval revalidates under the queue lock and commits through binding_approvals. No method pauses, resumes, steers or dispatches the reviewed task. Conflicts require another inspection or preview instead of silently refreshing the accepted source values.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/context.py Python A Locate the existing Parameter Store in a context mapping for skill adapters. Prefer an outer supported store, then its nested execution_context; accept both standalone and hub implementations. This lookup neither opens storage nor creates an independent repository, preserving the Controller’s shared authority.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/corrections.py Python A Own explicit user correction sessions and recoverable application of a reviewed rule. Inspection and preview are passive. Explicit call/task entry requests cooperative Pause through the existing control owner; selecting a call can retry that request. Application freezes accepted inputs, journals the intended rule, saves a mapping, records a structured amendment when needed and resumes through native controls. It never dispatches a tool: the Agent chooses its next operation. Terminal calls, later successful retries and unknown outcomes use future-only saving. Session revisions, idempotency receipts and pause stamps guard retries and ownership.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/defaults.py Python A Build fresh nonsecret default records for run temporary, final artifact and activity temporary directories. Values store environment-variable names and Gateway-execution guidance rather than paths captured on the Controller. Store initialization seeds only missing canonical keys, retaining user edits; this module does not create directories or read host environment values.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/diagnostics.py Python A Turn parameter-resolution failures into typed value-free facts and bounded runtime explanations. Strict models allow canonical names, size counts and enumerated storage causes; machine error codes distinguish busy/permission/full/corrupt/I/O failures without parsing arbitrary exception text. Recovery of old held tasks recognizes exact historical templates only. Admission and runtime-message callers own persistence and retry.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/drafting.py Python A Prepare editable Parameter Store drafts from user text without saving records. A supplied model client can classify and extract structured drafts; validation/model failures fall back to deterministic JSON, pasted-field, connection and credential heuristics. Normalizers retain explicit user data, repair field-label misreads and mark missing information. The caller owns model routing, user review and CRUD; sealed prompt text and response schemas remain runtime contracts.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/email_templates.py Python A Provide detached SMTP OAuth setup presets using the existing Auth profile types.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/fields.py Python A Generate value-free absolute JSON addresses for parameter manifests, paged reads and recovery from invalid pointers. Deterministic traversal preserves object/array types, caps callable pointers at 1,024 characters and marks deeper descendants. Manifest allocation retains metadata and whole entries within one shared character budget; it rejects an oversized minimum instead of truncating JSON. Binding and reference modules consume these pure helpers.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/learned_workflows.py Python A Teach reviewed ordered call sequences and launch them through ordinary tasks. Preview captures selected successful invocations, exact mapping revisions and source identities, assigning explicit predecessor and producer dependencies. Templates omit mapped values; future runs resolve accepted parameters and fresh current-run receipts through existing native workflow guards. Launch records, conversation identity and task lookup make interrupted creation recoverable. This feature is separate from saved-request Workflows; the Agent still issues each reviewed step and the normal admission/execution owners enforce it.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/mapping_store.py Python A Store versioned mapping definitions and their user-owned lifecycle documents. MappingStore uses the Parameter Store’s Controller RAM records when available, otherwise its standalone SQLite connection. Current documents and immutable revisions change together under compare-and-set and idempotency checks. Reads return detached payloads. Feedback records user assessment separately from tool settlement and can suspend the used rule revision; this layer never executes work.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/mappings.py Python A Describe and materialize exact user-reviewed argument mappings. Rules bind source identities and pointers to destinations under a tool contract and workspace/Gateway scope. Helpers build value-free source catalogs, structural templates and bounded SSH connection selectors; materialization reads accepted parameter snapshots or unambiguous fresh receipts. Only reviewed destinations are overwritten. This module neither selects work for the model nor dispatches it; invalid identities, pointers, types and protected destinations reject the mapping.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/memory_store.py Python A Own live Parameter Store values, revisions, search indexes and audits in the Controller hub. Atomic mutations enforce identity/dependency checks and publish detached models; usage accounting leaves configuration timestamps unchanged. Legacy value-search and exact metadata suggestions remain separate paths. Recovery/checkpoint schemas retain plaintext private data, while consumer/audit projection follows Auth privacy and configured redaction. The factory in store.py selects this repository and forbids direct runtime SQL.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/models.py Python A Define strict Parameter Store record, create/update, audit, summary and editable-draft shapes shared by storage, routes and model drafting. Field validators distinguish replacement Value JSON from optional Context JSON, while the store owns typed-profile and canonical-key checks. Summary fields carry already prepared consumer copies; model validation alone neither redacts nor encrypts them. Draft requests reject public model-route overrides and perform no inference or persistence.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/private_bindings.py Python A Recover the former opaque parameter-binding format through a locked process-local cache and an exact-revision store fallback. Missing old values fail instead of silently taking an edited record. Current reference acceptance stores ordinary literal records directly and protected Auth identities separately; these compatibility helpers do not provide a durable vault or create current snapshots.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/references.py Python A Parse literal-aware canonical @ references and capture their accepted values/mode once for task admission and resume. Ordinary records remain literal; Auth-protected profiles contribute safe identities. Enforce the full expansion and manifest budgets before inference, retain unresolved names for held-task recovery and defer usage accounting when requested. Model- facing PARAMETERS projection is detached, and aliases/fuzzy discovery never replace exact acceptance.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/ssh_mapping.py Python A Adapt explicitly reviewed connection roles in bounded literal SSH commands. The parser accepts supported literal words/options and returns connection fields plus the remote program; it rejects local expansion/compound syntax instead of evaluating shell code. Rendering validates host/user/port and preserves unrelated options and the remote program. Password authentication returns SSHPASS separately and emits sshpass -e. Callers own authorization, transport and execution.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/store.py Python A Provide the Parameter Store factory, standalone SQLite backend and shared compatibility projections/discovery helpers. Registered Controller paths use memory_store.py; standalone use enforces schema version 3, normalized identities, typed validation and record/audit transactions. Ordinary values remain plaintext and redaction controls consumer copies, not execution. Exact accepted references belong to references.py; legacy matching, dotted environment exports and database hints do not authorize operations. Session invalidation and revision-fenced Auth rotation preserve their separate boundaries.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/task_corrections.py Python A Provide persistent task-card entry and call selection for parameter correction. Passive projections read accepted binding mode and scalar invocation metadata to show availability without stopping work. Explicit Start creates or reopens one durable session and requests cooperative Pause before a call is chosen. Selection revalidates the current attempt, invocation digest and session revision, then uses the shared Corrections owner. Failed calls sort first; displayed argument summaries are masked, and picker phase changes preserve the same session/pause ownership.
src/agent_runtime/parameters/templates.py Python A Assemble detached editor drafts and dispatch recognized profile validation to each subsystem’s schema owner. Current HTTP profiles require literal version-3 provider fields; selection never saves, authenticates or enables a skill. Generic server/Git/credential checks report field rules without echoing values. Auth privacy plus optional PARAMETERS projection controls consumer copies; recognized type alone does not guarantee secret removal. Entry-tool promotion intersects installed skills with the already compiled capability envelope.
src/agent_runtime/permission_policy.py Python A Define and evaluate deterministic user permission policies independently of tool enablement and hard runtime safety. Typed rules cover Skills, tools and supported executable/subcommand families; helpers normalize precedence, evaluate concrete operations and construct proposed grants. Trusted authority owners validate one-shot confirmation and persist grants; this module performs no storage or execution.
src/agent_runtime/permission_scopes.py Python A Resolve user permission hierarchy and apply revision-checked grants across settings, chats and native runs. PermissionAuthority dispatches to MemoryPermissionAuthority for the live Controller RAM hub; this file also implements standalone attached-SQL transactions and shared precedence/grant logic. Audit records retain modes and revisions without prompts or rule bodies; policy evaluation and exact execution consent have separate collaborators.
src/agent_runtime/profiling.py Python A Request-scoped runtime profiling helpers.
src/agent_runtime/progress/init.py Python A User-only, deterministic observations. Never an execution authority.
src/agent_runtime/progress/main.py Python A Print developer progress coverage without exposing it to model tool schemas.
src/agent_runtime/progress/conformance.py Python A Offline extension checks; callers supply captured fixtures, never live services.
src/agent_runtime/progress/contracts.py Python A Define immutable, bounded progress evidence, parser state, public reports and per-skill provider declarations. Validators enforce measurement consistency, encoded-size limits and complete support classification; coverage reports implementation gaps without running extractors. Providers fold existing events synchronously, while publication, event collection and the private diagnostic latch belong to their callers.
src/agent_runtime/progress/engine.py Python A Bounded observational worker over captured traces; no execution-state writers.
src/agent_runtime/progress/evidence.py Python A Bound captured metadata/results without reading a provider or result service.
src/agent_runtime/progress/providers.py Python A Reusable pure extractors; business-specific templates belong to skills.
src/agent_runtime/progress/reporting.py Python A Invocation-bound, nonthrowing instrumentation; no results or execution decisions.
src/agent_runtime/progress/service.py Python A User read projection. Existing observation supplies identity, never accepts writes.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/init.py Python A Opt-in request construction controls; inference engines retain their own KV state.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/builders.py Python A Assemble source-owned helper requests from explicit producer inputs. Drafting, monitor judgment, repair and capability-selection builders preserve their existing delimiters and factual values; only permitted sections move and pure instruction fragments can be reused.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/catalog.py Python A Describe editable request sections and project known Task Contract sources. Public previews contain labels and protected boundaries only; the same layout algorithm serves previews and outgoing messages, while custom templates remain opaque.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/comparisons.py Python A Coordinate explicit bounded original/enabled model experiments. Capture routing and phase options, admit one job per endpoint, enforce physical retry/deadline/cancellation budgets and retain partial evidence. Separate arm clients use synthetic fixtures; returned operations are validated, never executed.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/diagnostics.py Python A Turn numeric request evidence into honest observations and paired-comparison statistics. Provider cache reports remain separate from local rendering savings; deterministic block-bootstrap intervals, baseline failures and correctness regressions constrain performance verdicts.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/fixtures.py Python A Construct synthetic phase inputs and run explicit comparison samples through production request builders, context measurement, scheduling and transport. prepare only builds inputs; sample can call the selected model but never dispatches its proposed operations or adopts them into a real task. Results retain validation, timing and contamination evidence.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/layout.py Python A Pin policy and guidance snapshots around request construction, then reorder only permitted producer-owned sections and reuse bounded pure renders. Keep reversible manifests for context fallback and continuation identities; optional numeric diagnostics are isolated from inference success and durable history.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_cache/policy.py Python A Publish immutable controller prompt-cache preferences without adding hot-path storage reads. PolicyOwner owns bounded fragment caches, numeric observations and setting-change listeners; switches control reordering, extra pure rendering reuse and diagnostics independently of inference-engine KV caching.
src/agent_runtime/prompt_identity.py Python A Exact text identity shared by scheduling and verified execution caching.
src/agent_runtime/prompts/init.py Python A Prompt access compatibility, loaded independently of sealed source resources.
src/agent_runtime/prompts/build.py Python A Compile explicit prompt authoring inputs into a deterministic release database. The compiler checks source bindings and helper variables; the CLI supports byte-for-byte verification or atomic read-only publication. It never discovers JSON inputs by walking directories or starts the application.
src/agent_runtime/prompts/catalog.py Python A Load and validate the sealed release instruction database, then expose canonical and effective request text. Definition validates template variables and supports local previews; source_skill supplies registry wording, while feedback/history views support exact projection and migration. Missing or damaged resources fail initialization.
src/agent_runtime/prompts/guidance_compact.py Python A Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.
src/agent_runtime/prompts/memory_store.py Python A Provide Controller-owned prompt storage through the RAM record authority. Legacy template methods remain available for import compatibility; PromptOverrides owns current edits and request snapshots, and the hub handles checkpoint/recovery. Direct SQL access is rejected.
src/agent_runtime/prompts/overrides.py Python A Preserve user instruction edits separately from release defaults. Revision-checked saves/resets publish immutable snapshots; one-time migration archives legacy evidence and retains uncertain edits. The same owner works with Controller records or standalone transactional SQL, without changing compact settings.
src/agent_runtime/prompts/store.py Python A Maintain helper-template compatibility around the sealed prompt catalog and user overrides. Controller paths use the RAM repository; standalone callers can use SQLite and explicit custom defaults. PromptFetcher selects a request snapshot, renders dollar placeholders locally and keeps canonical-history reads separate from effective outgoing text.
src/agent_runtime/rag/init.py Python A Shared, controller-owned document and Memory retrieval services.
src/agent_runtime/rag/backend.py Python A Private Qdrant transport and supervised, offline inference worker client.
src/agent_runtime/rag/budget.py Python A Count automatic evidence with the answer model's tokenizer when available.
src/agent_runtime/rag/cuda_install.py Python A Optional, separately locked CUDA dependencies and an offline real-inference gate.
src/agent_runtime/rag/embedding_application.py Python A Shared, account-owned embedding application and conditional restoration.
src/agent_runtime/rag/images.py Python A Project at most two authorized source images into a vision-capable model request.
src/agent_runtime/rag/install.py Python A Explicit, repairable RAG setup. Ordinary controller startup never invokes setup.
src/agent_runtime/rag/inventory.py Python A Record installed RAG package provenance and preserve their supplied license notices.
src/agent_runtime/rag/limits.py Python A Installation-owned resource ceilings, independent of per-user retrieval settings.
src/agent_runtime/rag/memory_index.py Python A Read Memory indexing progress from one account-owned, coherent state snapshot.
src/agent_runtime/rag/migration.py Python A Add the empty Knowledge domain to a fully verified pre-Knowledge checkpoint.
src/agent_runtime/rag/models.py Python A Validated retrieval profiles and public errors; credentials are never projected.
src/agent_runtime/rag/prerequisites.py Python A Provision missing interpreter/OCR prerequisites during explicit installation only.
src/agent_runtime/rag/process.py Python A Lifecycle for one installation-owned, authenticated loopback Qdrant process.
src/agent_runtime/rag/routes.py Python A Authenticated Knowledge API; the account-scoped service graph owns every identity.
src/agent_runtime/rag/runtime.py Python A Task-owned retrieval policy, durable indexing waits and bounded evidence projection.
src/agent_runtime/rag/self_test.py Python A Offline installation qualification using disposable sources and private vector indexes.
src/agent_runtime/rag/service.py Python A Scoped Knowledge operations and revision-fenced background indexing.
src/agent_runtime/rag/store.py Python A Authoritative Knowledge metadata in the per-user hub; SQL is recovery-only.
src/agent_runtime/rag/worker.py Python A Offline inference/extraction process. Only private JSON lines cross its stdio boundary.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/init.py Python A Native recipes and persistence.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/bindings.py Python A Interpret the closed JSON binding language used by recorded workflows. expression/expressions recognize exact parameter and prior-step references; render deep-copies literals and resolves fresh structured results, rejecting missing parameters and ambiguous array selection. leaves and replace support reviewed parameter edits by JSON pointer. Strings remain data, and this module performs no code evaluation, tool dispatch or authority changes.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/errors.py Python A Give recipe validation, capture and runtime constraints stable catalog-owned errors. RecipeError selects a bounded public description and emits a nonexecuted error receipt; ParameterBindingCaptureError explains why resolved parameter values cannot be captured as reusable literals. Rejected payloads are not interpolated into these diagnostics. Callers choose HTTP/native projection and recovery behavior.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/memory_store.py Python A Store recipe definitions, immutable execution revisions and run claims on the Controller RAM authority. RecipeRecords maintains ordered indexes; MemoryRecipeStore publishes validated edits, overlap checks and first-settlement counters atomically. Recorded-workflow retention preserves uncertain effects; saved requests have separate idempotency/open-run rules. Recovery tables seed the repository and shared checkpoints save it, while runtime access never falls back to SQL or dispatches tasks.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/models.py Python A Define recipe definition, parameter, revision and run-history data shared by RAM/standalone stores and adapters. The models retain native_intent, recorded_workflow_v1 and saved_request_v1 kinds, while current HTTP routes accept saved requests through narrower payloads. Execution hashes and semantic constraints are computed by validation/store layers; these Pydantic contracts themselves neither authorize nor execute work.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/native.py Python A Support retained native-intent recipes separately from current saved-request HTTP workflows. capture builds a reusable goal/obligation contract from accepted completion; invocation validates typed parameters, requires fresh evidence and intersects capability ceilings. execute_recipe enters the ordinary model-led runtime; explicit resume context retains its identities. This compatibility path does not replay old receipts or automatically convert other artifact kinds.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/privacy.py Python A Prevent known credential material from entering reusable recorded-workflow definitions and history. check traverses JSON using the canonical database redaction classifier, rejecting detected secrets instead of silently modifying values; source_secrets collects owned provenance and reference validates bounded @name syntax. Typed expressions defer value checks to admission. This boundary does not rewrite ordinary execution arguments or guarantee detection inside arbitrary binary attachments.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/recorded_workflow.py Python A Define the retained recorded-workflow graph and its execution identity. RecordedWorkflow validates ordered dependencies, typed result references, manual/optional constraints and size limits; WorkflowStep stores reviewed tool contracts and effects. execution_hash identifies execution-affecting revisions, while risk_summary derives structural counts and unattended eligibility. These schemas neither replay receipts nor grant current tool permission; validation/runtime modules enforce invocation requirements.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/recorder.py Python A Extract retained recorded-workflow candidates from accepted native completion and owned durable receipts. extract verifies dependency topology, current tool contracts and fresh structured result bindings; capture returns bounded eligibility errors, and suggestions proposes typed parameter edits without applying them. Unknown effects, unprovable/ambiguous producers, resolved parameter bindings and detected secrets block capture. No model is called, no receipt is replayed and interactive desktop action recording remains explicitly unavailable.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/runtime.py Python A Constrain retained recorded-workflow execution inside the normal native Agent loop. invocation revalidates current contracts/scope; guard persists step ownership before effects, observe records fresh receipt outcomes, and control_guard prevents alternate execution surfaces or premature completion. Human checkpoints use the existing input boundary; adapter-owned reconciliation can establish an applied uncertain effect without retrying it. History stores step/receipt references while output bodies remain in the owned result store. This module dispatches no tools itself.
src/agent_runtime/recipes/saved_request.py Python A Capture current Workflows as exact prompts, saved execution intent and independently owned optional context.
