src/agent_runtime/tasks/dependencies.py Python A Share top-level task edge parsing and deterministic eligibility between RAM and retained SQL repositories. evaluate_rows computes waiting/blocked/satisfied projections from immutable task intent and explicit per-edge waivers. The SQL helpers validate and record edges inside the caller transaction, while memory_dependencies owns RAM writes. This layer never executes tasks or invents success for a failed prerequisite.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/lanes.py Python A Own standalone SQL transactions for conversation submissions, future queue order, explicit dependencies and durable request/attempt bindings. Enqueue deduplicates client intent, reservation commits identity before native dispatch, and recovery revalidates parent/status/capacity. Lane projections explain why queued work waits; explicit start/stop/skip actions persist narrow dependency decisions. Retention and deletion preserve submission/request tombstones. Native RunStore supplies execution truth and the queue coordinator delivers cancellation/recovery; this module does not run model turns or external commands.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/memory_dependencies.py Python A Own top-level task prerequisite transitions in the active RAM transaction. MemoryDependencies validates creation intent, maintains dependency checkpoints and revisits affected descendants plus their ancestors through shared graph evaluation. The mixin relies on MemoryTaskStore inserts/lane versions and TaskRecords reverse indexes; it does not dispatch work, alter native Activity graphs or waive unrelated dependencies.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/memory_lanes.py Python A Own conversation task ordering, replay bindings and recovery transitions on Controller RAM. MemoryLanes composes with MemoryTaskStore and its dependency/preparation helpers; read operations share a snapshot and writes publish through the hub. Admission stores intent and outbox notices, while the conversation coordinator starts native work and delivers steering. Revision, retirement and dependency guards reject stale transitions; request bindings survive deletion to prevent identity reuse.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/memory_preparations.py Python A Implement the same private preparation protocol on Controller RAM authority. MemoryPreparations uses task repository read/operation decorators to claim one source, publish state under an 8 MiB serialized limit and consume only through a live request/attempt binding. Source identity is checked again in the save transaction; stale, cancelled or deleted records cannot accept late compiler output. Shared import validation preserves policy and model provenance. TaskRecords owns related deletion/cancellation hooks, and checkpoints serialize these native JSON records for recovery.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/memory_records.py Python A Adapt the existing task schema to Controller RAM authority and maintain derived indexes. operation/read scope composed repository methods to one immutable view or optimistic publication; TaskRecords discovers restore schemas and updates creation/lane order, reverse prerequisites, timing, retention and native capacity signals. SQLite initialization supports restore/checkpoint generations; runtime consumers use Records rather than connections.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/memory_store.py Python A Store durable task intent, attempts and checkpoints on the Controller RAM authority. MemoryTaskStore joins lane, preparation, dependency and timing mixins; TaskRecords maintains indexes and checkpoint-recovery representation. Methods return detached validated models and publish related changes atomically, with explicit late-write tombstones and protected history pruning. Runtime SQL access is rejected; this store neither invokes models nor establishes that remote effects have settled.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/models.py Python A Define task creation, patches and persisted task/attempt/checkpoint views shared by API and repositories. Pydantic validates the public shapes, strict dependency selectors and input bounds; creation normalizes Gateway/Behavior Policy context. These records separate durable intent from request attempts and trace evidence. Runtime admission, dependencies, authority and execution remain with their owners; comments preserve all schema-producing docstrings and field declarations.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/preparation_compiler.py Python A Adapt the shared Task Contract compiler to an explicitly invoked queued-preparation session. QueuedCompilationSession copies accepted input/policy, owns inference budget and cancellation checks, routes safe events to task checkpoints and saves through the current SQL/RAM repository. prepare_task_contract claims the source before client creation and persists final outcomes without creating a native run, execution attempt or Gateway workload. Current production queue code consumes existing preparations but does not automatically call this generation helper. Client creation and ordinary compiler recovery can make model calls when an internal caller invokes it.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/preparation_models.py Python A Define the private durable TaskPreparation record and accepted-source identity used by both store backends. The record separates compilation lifecycle, source revision, model/prompt provenance, attempt state and first consumption from task execution status. preparation_identity hashes only compiler-relevant accepted input and snapshots, so queue reorder or dependency outcomes do not replace intent. Storage and authenticated import enforce transitions and authority; these shapes do not invoke inference or execute tools.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/preparations.py Python A Own standalone SQL transactions for queued compiler claims, source-checked saves and authenticated consumption. TaskPreparations composes with AgentTaskStore and keeps one current preparation per accepted source; existing matching results are reused instead of silently recompiling. validate_preparation_import is shared with RAM and checks request lineage, accepted policy and compiler provenance before returning a portable snapshot. Failed or deleted intent cannot be revived by a late response. The module performs no model calls; the separate compiler session supplies them.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/runtime_admission.py Python A Hold accepted tasks whose Parameter references need user attention before model or tool execution. Shared RAM/SQL transaction helpers persist revisioned Runtime issues, checkpoint history and explicit recheck/literal/cancel decisions. Usage recording can fail after acceptance and retains the original error for caller retry while publishing safe diagnostics. Request presentations join task-owned history without copying its authority into request journals.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/store.py Python A Provide the task repository facade and standalone SQLite persistence for accepted goals, attempts and activity checkpoints. Hub-owned paths return the shared RAM repository; unowned paths use this class and its lane/preparation/timing mixins. Generic CRUD, dependency-aware selection, bounded history and guarded deletion support the task sheet and queue coordinator. Task records are projections of accepted intent and execution progress, not the native execution authority. Native history, scratch scopes, external cancellation and physical/model admission have separate lifecycle owners.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/timing.py Python A Project task or individual-request wall time from persisted lifecycle and compact trace receipts. project sweeps clipped intervals into waiting, active, thinking, execution, overlap and unmeasured categories without counting parallel work twice. project_request excludes ancestors; advance extrapolates only the current category of a running payload. TaskTimingProjector reads all attempts and compact headers, checks a source signature and optionally saves a derived cache. It starts no timer, replays no event journal and does not infer execution success or internal model reasoning.
src/agent_runtime/tasks/timing_store.py Python A Persist additive task lifecycle boundaries and derived timing caches for RAM and standalone SQL. Schema helpers create tables and install SQL observation triggers only where appropriate; memory_changed joins the corresponding task mutation in the hub. timing_inputs returns every attempt independently of UI pagination, and save_timing fences absent/deleted tasks. RAM recovery disables SQL triggers and skips live observation hooks so replay cannot fabricate historical duration evidence.

src/agent_runtime/unsafe_policy.py Python A Global user policy for independently classified unsafe operations.

src/controller_inference/manager.py Python A Integrate Portal lifecycle work with controller authority and model-request admission. InferenceManager persists operation intents/receipts, checks revisions, owns transition holds and publishes detached launches/bindings for dispatch. ManagedRoute applies the same boundary to HTTP and typed tool calls; extra_router adds connections, cache policy and operation views. Portal owns worker processes and its separate SQLite/secret stores. Accepted operations can outlive callers; failed cleanup or rollback keeps truthful durable state for recovery.
src/controller_inference/migration.py Python A Recover installation-owned inference state before its manager opens the store.
src/controller_inference/skill.py Python A Expose shared inference management contracts to the agent's controller-local tool registry. InferenceTool builds the runtime tool definition and bridges synchronous execution to the manager event loop; build_skill declares discovery and resource actions. Redacted errors, unknown timeout effects and durable receipt IDs preserve truthful lifecycle reporting. Model-facing descriptions and schemas below are executable inputs and stay unchanged.

src/controller_inference/static/inference-timeline.js JavaScript A Mount an inference activity timeline, retain bounded observations, reconcile filters and draw overlapping operation series.

src/controller_inference/static/inference.html HTML A Provide the controller-integrated Inference page, using controller authentication/navigation around shared setup and operation sections.
src/controller_inference/static/inference.js JavaScript A Compose controller inference views for builds, model connections, durable operations and subsystem status. Shared Portal editors supply the underlying management controls.
src/controller_inference/status.py Python A Build the user serving indicator from detached launch and content-free request observations. InferenceStatus synchronizes bounded request identities, selected targets and operation state for snapshots/notifications without provider I/O. status_router also exposes the explicit resume-last user command, delegating execution authority to the manager's existing lifecycle queue; this command preserves newer saved configuration and is not a model tool.
src/controller_inference/telemetry.py Python A Correlate existing model HTTP attempts, GPU samples and backend counters for the user timeline. Capture owns bounded in-memory records and cursor/retention semantics; Telemetry owns detached launch attribution, registered-host sampling and listener/task cleanup. The router binds each capture to its user and renewal lease. No prompts, responses or capture state are persisted, and starting/stopping observation neither submits inference nor changes worker configuration.
src/error_catalog/init.py Python A Expose the shared definition/occurrence API to runtime, Gateway and manual callers without importing those applications. Re-export immutable mapping types, registry lookups and resolver projections; installed JSON is loaded lazily by registry use. This facade owns no settings, storage or recovery action.
src/error_catalog/main.py Python A Print installed canonical diagnostics for launchers without application dependencies.
src/error_catalog/audit.py Python A Discover production error producers and report unresolved source coverage without hiding gaps.
src/error_catalog/compatibility.py Python A Keep legacy USER_MESSAGES, LLM_MESSAGES and TEXT consumers tied to one installed catalog. Dictionary/template projections preserve historic tuple order and source keys; CatalogText carries identity through existing exception strings. source_message renders bounded primitive values without discarding required whitespace. Bootstrap projections keep older callers usable when catalog data is unavailable; execution decisions remain caller-owned.
src/error_catalog/http_boundary.py Python A Add canonical error presentation at Agent, Gateway and manual HTTP boundaries while preserving status and execution evidence. enrich_failure handles diagnostic fields; middleware examines bounded complete JSON responses; install registers exception handlers and optional cached definition/lookup/browser-subset routes. Successful target HTTP receipts remain intact. This module neither sanitizes every business payload nor supplies authentication or recovery authority.
src/error_catalog/manual_projection.py Python A Generate searchable deep error documentation from the installed canonical catalog.
src/error_catalog/models.py Python A Provide detached immutable JSON carriers for canonical error definitions and individual occurrences. freeze and thaw convert mappings/arrays between read-only records and caller-owned projections; ErrorDefinition supports mapping and attribute lookup. These types freeze supplied data but do not validate definitions or redact secrets: schema, registry and resolver own those boundaries.
src/error_catalog/recovery.py Python A Registered recovery navigation and guidance; component owners retain execution authority.
src/error_catalog/redaction.py Python A Sanitize diagnostic facts before they reach public error surfaces, independently of optional application redaction. secret_values gathers bounded explicit credentials and encoded variants from supplied data; safe_text removes known values and credential patterns; sanitize detaches JSON-like structures with traversal limits. No secret store is read, and original execution evidence stays with its owner.
src/error_catalog/registry.py Python A Load and validate the installed error_msg.json once, then share immutable definitions and exact GUID/ID/slug/alias indexes under a process-local cache and lock. Lookup helpers serve runtime and generated manual consumers; version and raw-content fingerprint support HTTP caching. Failed loads are cached to avoid recursive file reads; public projection boundaries provide bootstrap diagnostics.
src/error_catalog/remediation.py Python A Validate semantic error setting links against a supplied real settings registry.
src/error_catalog/renderer.py Python A Turn catalog definitions and supported occurrence facts into human guidance, legacy Markdown and semantic settings links. interpolate accepts only declared public primitive placeholders; legacy_copy and occurrence_presentation preserve certainty and measured/estimated distinctions. message_markdown fences technical text and settings_actions maps retained targets to current sections. These are pure presentation operations and do not change settings or execution truth.
src/error_catalog/resolver.py Python A Connect structured producer causes to stable catalog identities and bounded public occurrence envelopes. fields and resolve_error_ref preserve typed/source precedence; resolve_error combines static guidance with sanitized facts and unknown-effect cautions. project_error_detail refreshes historical presentation while retaining occurrence identity when available. Bootstrap diagnostics avoid catalog recursion; no receipt, retry decision or persisted state is changed.
src/error_catalog/schema.py Python A Reject malformed installed catalog data before registry publication. validate_catalog checks field sets, canonical unique identities/aliases, guidance/remedy contracts, template declarations and acyclic canonical relations, returning the validated input mapping. This structural validation does not establish that a remedy matches its producer or that a settings target exists; review evidence and remediation validation provide those separate checks.
src/error_catalog/startup.py Python A Project startup failures without echoing configuration inputs.
src/error_catalog/tool_diagnostics.py Python A Preserve canonical causes as failed tool receipts move between full and compact views. tool_error_detail selects established cause fields and stable occurrence identity, compact_tool_error retains a small protected diagnostic, and retain_cause refines adapter guidance without changing wire status/effect facts. Success receipts pass through; arbitrary tool output is not searched for error identities.

These helpers neither select permissions nor mutate the original request or receipt.
src/gateway_core/app.py Python A Compose the authenticated inbound Gateway API around one GatewayService. create_app constructs service state, binds controller pairing and installs private validation, typed operation routes, job/command SSE and terminal WebSockets. The ASGI lifespan holds the state lease and owns maintenance/update startup and service teardown. Route adapters preserve receipt and failure semantics; domain providers own host effects. The exported LazyApplication delays default construction until use or attribute inspection.
src/gateway_core/archive_capabilities.py Python A Build sanitized archive-operation facts for Gateway capability discovery. archive_support locates allowlisted tools, caches help/info probes by executable/codec identity and returns defensive copies; parser helpers distinguish read/extract/create/verify evidence. canonical_archive_support removes untrusted extras before persistence or model projection. Missing or malformed facts stay UNKNOWN; discovery does not authorize archive execution, install tools or inspect user archives.
src/gateway_core/artifact_discovery.py Python A Discover candidate generated files beneath one workspace or publishable temp directory. eligible filters internal and unfinished-looking names; snapshot performs bounded no-follow traversal and returns stat metadata rather than file contents. Collector callers decide writer readiness and later verify/open/hash each candidate. A failed scan raises an artifact error so incomplete discovery cannot masquerade as authoritative deletion evidence.
src/gateway_core/artifact_maintenance.py Python A Own only Gateway artifact caches and their associated publishable task temp. ArtifactMaintenance coordinates in-process request/stream activity, protects recorded active or recent jobs and clears eligible caches at startup or after daily expiry. Missing/offline ownership evidence defers deletion. Controller versions, private scratch and unrelated shared temp are outside this owner; no remote job is stopped by cache cleanup.
src/gateway_core/artifact_retirement.py Python A Retire an authenticated run's managed files after its physical writers end.
src/gateway_core/artifact_temp.py Python A Stage eligible temporary output into a run artifact workspace without granting arbitrary host-file access. reference_source distinguishes managed run paths, mapped /tmp aliases and explicit legacy OS-temp references. destination_parent and stage pin directory/source identity, copy to a private partial and atomically publish a verified copy. dispatch_temp exposes bounded discovery or staging metadata; Controller registration and content hashing remain separate.
src/gateway_core/artifact_workspace.py Python A Own the run artifact filesystem boundary used by Controller adapters and every Gateway platform. Hashed conversation/run paths separate namespaces; environment creates generated-file, scratch and temporary directories, while contained_path/open_source reject unsafe aliases. ArtifactRequest and dispatch expose setup, metadata discovery, staging and bounded revision-checked reads. Callers supply authentication and run ownership; this boundary stays active independently of optional execution guards.
src/gateway_core/auth_middleware.py Python A Enforce controller authentication at the Gateway ASGI boundary before protected operation dispatch. Public health and bounded pairing have explicit paths; signed HTTP/WebSocket requests bind the actual target and body, replay state and runtime epoch. Verified bodies are replayed to the app under purge/policy admission, while response observations and cleanup retain context ownership. Post-dispatch failures propagate as operation outcomes rather than safe auth rejection.
src/gateway_core/bash_startup.py Python A Interactive Bash setup shared by the workspace and managed terminal shells.

src/gateway_core/cancellable_io.py Python A Request-owned sockets for synchronous HTTP, including TLS and response waits.
src/gateway_core/client_auth.py Python A Define the v1 controller/Gateway proof format and cryptographic validation helpers shared by both transport directions. src/gateway_core/clipboard_service.py Python A Dispatch explicit clipboard calls with bounded lifetime and run-owned image output.
src/gateway_core/clipboard_worker.py Python A Provide a killable boundary for native pasteboard IPC that has no cancellation API.
src/gateway_core/code_editor_context.py Python A Immutable editor references; source stays on the gateway until explicitly read.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace.py Python A Conversation-owned source trees, fenced editing, snapshots and reversible changes.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_changes.py Python A Stable, line-based views of committed workspace edits, independent of live files.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_git.py Python A Managed local worktree preparation; user Git commands use the normal executor.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_history.py Python A Bounded historical content transport; old journal content remains immutable.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_metadata.py Python A Content-compatible workspace identities that also account for file metadata.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_permissions.py Python A Journal permission changes without requiring read access to the target bytes.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_preparation.py Python A Durable identities for long execution-copy preparation; never launches user commands.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_projects.py Python A Explicitly connected project roots; workspace metadata never owns external source.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_reads.py Python A Bounded project exploration, independent of total repository size.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_snapshots.py Python A Saved execution copies and metadata-aware, conflict-checked source imports.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_terminal_context.py Python A Bounded, read-only evidence from an already existing project terminal.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_tools.py Python A Coding-agent conveniences on project source: find, filtered search, diagnostics and command edit observation.
src/gateway_core/code_workspace_transfer.py Python A Resumable, bounded binary uploads published through the workspace source journal.
src/gateway_core/config.py Python A Resolve typed Gateway bootstrap settings and cached effective configuration. Runtime provider probes still own actual readiness; parsing a setting neither authenticates requests nor launches operations.
src/gateway_core/configuration.py Python A Expose the Gateway managed-settings contract to authenticated inbound and outbound transports. ConfigurationService binds Settings, the startup base and active process values to ManagedSettings, limits editable fields, protects the CDP endpoint and validates get/preview/update/reset requests. Writes require the observed revision; saved changes do not mutate the running services. Node identity, state roots and derived platform facts remain with their separate lifecycle owners.
src/gateway_core/desktop_contract.py Python A Validate Desktop requests and project bounded native observations.
src/gateway_core/desktop_service.py Python A Dispatch native Desktop operations with bounded cancellation ownership.
src/gateway_core/dispatch.py Python A Typed Gateway operation dispatch shared by network and embedded transports.

src/gateway_core/docker/backend.py Python A Translate typed operations into exact Engine objects and projected receipts.
src/gateway_core/docker/build.py Python A Create a bounded local build archive using Docker ignore semantics.
src/gateway_core/docker/cache.py Python A Inspect and delete exact immutable reclaimable BuildKit cache IDs.
src/gateway_core/docker/compose.py Python A Resolve explicit Compose identity and execute typed lifecycle operations.
src/gateway_core/docker/engine.py Python A Negotiate the Engine API and own bounded local socket I/O.
src/gateway_core/docker/models.py Python A Define bounded typed Engine/Compose operations and stable error identities.
src/gateway_core/docker/plugin_config.py Python A Discover installed Docker plugins inside an isolated CLI configuration.
src/gateway_core/docker/privacy.py Python A Project private Docker content through the canonical redaction processor.
src/gateway_core/docker/prune.py Python A Bind destructive previews to exact categories, objects and Engine revision.
src/gateway_core/docker/semantics.py Python A Share literal Shell and typed Docker effects, scopes and capacity claims.
src/gateway_core/docker/service.py Python A Own local dispatch, cancellation, replay fencing and bounded receipts.

src/gateway_core/email_contract.py Python A Define strict SMTP profiles, safe identities and private Gateway request envelopes.
src/gateway_core/email_runtime.py Python A Dispatch private Email operations for inbound and outbound Gateways.
src/gateway_core/email_staging.py Python A Stage bounded MIME chunks with hash, expiry and invocation ownership checks.
src/gateway_core/execution_terminals.py Python A Workspace execution lanes over the existing job/process authority.
src/gateway_core/executor.py Python A Launch ordinary target-host shell commands and report their process receipts. stream_command owns cwd and temporary-directory preparation, resource coordination, process registration, pipe threads, timeout/cancellation and cleanup. execute_command buffers the same stream under a shared output limit. Platform helpers construct shell argv and stop only owned processes. GatewayJobs and privilege consume these events; authorization and durable effect reconciliation belong to their separate owners.
src/gateway_core/fd_install.py Python A Install the pinned native fd fallback during setup, never during a file operation.
src/gateway_core/fd_runtime.py Python A Discover a supported native fd executable on the selected Gateway.
src/gateway_core/file_common.py Python A Shared safety and receipt primitives for Gateway File operations. Operation binds paths, namespace, cancellation/deadline and effect accounting; CursorStore retains bounded continuation metadata. Revision/opening helpers detect stale observations, text helpers preserve encoding and newline intent, and Stage publishes private sibling files with explicit cleanup and durability facts. File providers and read/mutation modules consume these helpers; OS errors propagate into receipts that retain any changes already made. Revisions describe stat metadata, not content hashes, and path checks honor accepted roots and runtime policy rather than providing an unconditional filesystem sandbox.
src/gateway_core/file_contract.py Python A Public argument contracts and private transport envelopes for Gateway File operations. Schema builders and SPECS describe bounded tools without accessing either controller or Gateway files; validate returns detached checked arguments without echoing content in errors. FileRequest separates model arguments from authenticated namespace, guard and task scope, while destructive_scopes classifies explicit mutation structure for approval policy. Shared constants bound input, output and traversal work; operation implementations own defaults, actual effects and cancellation. Tool descriptions and schemas are runtime inputs and remain byte-for-byte unchanged by adjacent documentation.
src/gateway_core/file_diff_worker.py Python A Isolated CPU worker for Gateway text comparisons. main receives already-read line arrays and labels over bounded stdin JSON, computes a capped unified diff with stdlib difflib and returns counts/completeness over stdout. It does not access the labeled paths or mutate files. file_mutate launches the process and terminates it on deadline expiry, keeping potentially expensive diff work outside the Gateway request thread.
src/gateway_core/file_find.py Python A Adapt bounded fd discovery to Gateway path authority and structured receipts.
src/gateway_core/file_manage.py Python A Gateway copy, move and deletion with explicit partial-effect accounting. tree preflights bounded recursive inventories; copy streams stable regular files through private stages, recreates links and applies directory metadata after children. move uses native no-clobber or explicit replacement rename, falling back on EXDEV to copy, content verification and source deletion. delete removes planned entries without following link targets. Shared path/revision helpers and Walker enforce accepted boundaries; failures preserve already changed paths rather than promising whole-tree rollback.
src/gateway_core/file_metadata.py Python A Preserve extended attributes while Gateway mutations prepare private replacement files. The DarwinAttributes adapter binds descriptor-based libc calls; copy_extended_attributes selects that adapter or os xattr functions and enforces bounded names and aggregate values. Source and destination descriptors pin the files, and copy failures prevent the caller from publishing the stage. Unsupported APIs add a warning; available APIs do not guarantee volume or ACL support. File reads do not invoke this metadata-copy path.
src/gateway_core/file_mutate.py Python A Gateway single-file text mutation and comparison operations. mkdirs creates bounded parent chains; write handles explicit create/replace/append modes; edit preflights exact anchors and publishes once; diff compares supplied or observed text in a deadline-bounded child process. Shared File primitives own namespace checks, revisions, metadata-preserving stages and receipt accounting. Dry runs avoid writes, while append and multi-directory creation retain partial effects on failure. Diff never mutates its inputs and returns counts only for its bounded output.
src/gateway_core/file_patch.py Python A Exact multi-file unified patches on the selected Gateway. Parser helpers validate file headers, counted hunks and logical newline presence; apply_hunks requires exact positions/context. patch resolves and preflights all targets, bounds aggregate old/new bytes, stages outputs and deletion backups, then commits sequentially. Failure triggers guarded reverse recovery with explicit per-file rollback results; multiple targets remain non-atomic. Shared Operation/Stage helpers own path policy, revisions, metadata, counters and cleanup, and runtime receipts distinguish restored content from an attempt that never executed.
src/gateway_core/file_paths.py Python A Resolve Gateway-local Files operands in the accepted run namespace.
src/gateway_core/file_provider.py Python A Dispatch authenticated File requests on the selected Gateway filesystem. FileProvider validates request size and configured schemas, resolves cwd/private run namespaces, checks guard/task scope, coordinates mutations and delegates to read, traversal, search, mutation and management owners. stat supplies inexpensive path observations; all operations produce receipts through Operation, retaining partial changes and native failure identities. Provider-local cursor keys invalidate old continuations after restart. The provider uses no shell interpreter or inference; individual find/search/diff owners may use bounded helper processes.
src/gateway_core/file_read.py Python A Bounded Gateway text/byte observations and streamed content hashes. fragments decodes strict incremental text without buffering entire long lines; tail_offset locates trailing ranges in fixed blocks. read validates fresh ranges or provider-scoped continuation metadata, preserves byte/character/newline positions and distinguishes a complete requested range from the end of the file. hash_file computes SHA-256 without retaining content. Shared pinned opens and before/after revision checks reject stale identity; cursors never hold file contents or authorize access beyond the current operation.
src/gateway_core/file_results.py Python A Resource-binding schemas for structured File receipt fields. result_schema identifies optional paths, revisions, cursors and discovered-entry fields for supported operations so downstream bindings can refer to observed resources. These declarations exclude file content and do not validate complete execution receipts or guarantee success. The operation owner remains responsible for effects, failure and completeness fields.
src/gateway_core/file_search.py Python A Gateway content search with bounded matches, excerpts and context. search walks selected regular files, reads strict current text and checks revisions before retaining results; oversized lines and unavailable content remain visible through skip counts and incomplete reasons. lines bounds logical-line buffering, while rg_locations optionally accelerates a narrow class of small UTF-8 literal searches using supplied stdin text and capped JSON output. Native matching remains available when acceleration is absent or unsuitable; no shell, user ripgrep configuration or persistent content index is used.
src/gateway_core/file_walk.py Python A Live deterministic traversal and portable matching shared by File listing, content search and recursive mutations. Glob/regex helpers validate bounded patterns without caching filesystem observations; IgnoreRule and Walker apply inherited filters, track active ancestry, pin directories and cap enumeration and errors. listing shapes sorted metadata rows with completeness reasons and a current root revision. Partial walks remain usable for observation, while recursive mutation preflight rejects them. Matching and traversal use the caller operation's namespace, deadline and cancellation state.
src/gateway_core/file_windows.py Python A Open existing Windows content files while retaining native failure identities. kernel32 caches typed API bindings and open_file uses CreateFileW without creating, truncating or following a reparse-point leaf, then transfers handle ownership to a non-inheritable CRT descriptor. Gateway regular-file helpers perform the surrounding metadata checks and own descriptor closure. Failure before transfer closes the native handle; CreateFileW failures preserve winerror so sharing violations remain distinguishable from generic permission errors.
src/gateway_core/git_context.py Python A Observe repository setup from bounded local filesystem metadata alongside authorized Gateway work. repository resolves worktrees/gitfiles/bare repositories and configuration revisions; observe reports discovered or stale roots, while configuration helpers interpret only a conservative supported grammar. No Git helper, branch/status query, remote connection or persistent cache is created. Literal remote values are metadata, not credential-redacted output or execution authority; callers own publication and projection.
src/gateway_core/gmail_bulk.py Python A Execute grouped Gmail state operations on the request-owned Gateway IMAP connection. Revalidate exact Gmail IDs and UIDVALIDITY, batch flags/labels/moves, use targeted UID EXPUNGE for explicit deletion and verify APPENDUID on import. Partial and uncertain outcomes preserve substep evidence without a controller fallback or mailbox mirror.
src/gateway_core/gmail_imap.py Python A Adapt live Gmail IMAP to request-owned Gateway operations using verified TLS, private protocol logging and bounded MIME/protocol reads. Gmail extension IDs and special-use folders preserve identity across localized mailboxes. Scoped single-use cursors, exact UID checks and acknowledged-write tracking support reads, draft cleanup and grouped mailbox actions without a persistent mirror.
src/gateway_core/gmail_profile.py Python A Validate and project the one shared Gmail app-password record used by Gmail IMAP and Email SMTP. Fixed verified Gmail endpoints prevent arbitrary host/TLS configuration; safe public metadata excludes the password and reports configuration rather than tested connectivity. SMTP conversion is private and creates no independent credential store.
src/gateway_core/gmail_runtime.py Python A Own private Gmail Gateway request dispatch and volatile cursor/blob handles. Enforce run/operation ownership, ordered hashed transfers, capacity/expiry limits and a cancellable request deadline before opening one mailbox session. Large results use the same private ticket lifecycle; lost write evidence remains uncertain, and no transfer or cursor survives process restart.
src/gateway_core/gpu/init.py Python A Bounded, deterministic selected-Gateway GPU services.
src/gateway_core/gpu/adapter.py Python A Typed provider boundary for Gateway GPU observations and configuration. GpuAdapter describes readiness, device/client reads, capability inspection and one UUID mutation; checkpoint enforces cooperative cancellation/deadlines. mutation_argv compiles typed values into the existing strict NVIDIA grammar and refuses any command outside GPU configuration. Gateway orchestration owns admission and readback; providers own bounded hardware transport, with no arbitrary command, model call or client-process termination API.
src/gateway_core/gpu/models.py Python A Shared closed GPU arguments, private request envelope and canonical receipts. SPECS/SCHEMAS define read and configuration operations, selectors and sampling bounds; validate enforces strict identities and finite typed values before dispatch. GpuRequest carries trusted reset authority separately from public arguments, while GpuError preserves possible effects with safe catalog remediation. validate_response checks only common receipt fields; transport and operation owners enforce size and detailed state. Runtime schemas and tool descriptions are preserved by adjacent comments.
src/gateway_core/gpu/nvidia.py Python A NVIDIA implementation of the typed GPU provider boundary. NvidiaAdapter discovers the installed CLI, runs only grammar-approved argv without a shell and reads bounded CSV/XML observations keyed by UUID. Shared telemetry conversion retains unsupported values as null; device detail, process observations and installed help determine eligible configuration. apply sends one typed request, while bounded child cleanup and catalog errors retain uncertainty after possible mutation. Current clocks do not prove locked constraints, and this adapter neither elevates privileges nor kills GPU clients.
src/gateway_core/gpu/service.py Python A Gateway owner for bounded GPU observations, sampling and admitted configuration. GpuService tracks active calls/recent IDs in RAM, coordinates Local AI startup and binds mutations to exact UUID resources through GatewayJobs. It rechecks current support after admission, applies once and separates observable readback from uncertain clock/reset outcomes. Job reconciliation facts use the shared RAM authority and asynchronous recovery checkpoints; the older durable-admission wording below does not imply a synchronous disk barrier for every update. Unknown effects retain resource ownership instead of triggering automatic replay.
src/gateway_core/gpu/telemetry.py Python A Shared NVIDIA telemetry conversion for GPU tools and runtime observations. parse_gpu_devices maps nine-column CSV to UUID-keyed sorted devices with byte units, bounded percentages and null unsupported metrics. parse_gpu_utilization aggregates available index readings without turning missing measurements into zero. number and percent centralize numeric handling; these functions parse supplied text only and do not query a driver, retain sample history or infer process ownership.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/init.py Python A Expose the single HTTP authentication provider registry used by profile validation, value overlays and Gateway execution. provider selects fixed implementations and lazily loads OAuth; requirements reports credential inputs without opening sockets. The HTTP client and AuthFlow retain request/session ownership.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/config.py Python A Define closed version-3 HTTP connection, TLS and provider configuration schemas and their additional header/extraction checks. obj builds shared schema fragments; validate_auth rejects unsupported structure and unsafe injection rules before request preparation. These exported schema values are consumed at runtime and remain unchanged by adjacent documentation.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/connection.py Python A Translate user-facing literal connection recipes into the common HTTP provider schema. compile_connection_auth deep-copies input, expands shorthand session-login fields and extraction, and rejects conflicting/invalid configuration. This shared compiler lets controller connection flows and Gateway providers agree without saving credentials or contacting a target.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/flow.py Python A Perform bounded authentication exchanges on the selected Gateway HTTP session.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/oauth.py Python A Keep the Gateway provider import compatible while the controller Auth package owns OAuth protocol mechanics. Re-export OAuth2 from agent_runtime.auth.http_compat without a second implementation or additional state; the provider registry consumes this alias.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/providers.py Python A Implement explicit HTTP credential placement and session-login mappings for the Gateway HTTP client. Providers prepare headers, URL/query, cookies, bodies or requests auth handlers; SessionLogin uses AuthFlow for bounded login exchanges and retained session state. Credential requirements and execution share the registry, while optional enterprise handlers are loaded only when selected.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/urls.py Python A Resolve authentication endpoint URLs and explain the resolution in activity metadata. resolve_auth_url validates standard urljoin results; describe_auth_endpoint selects login/token/discovery/request-level endpoints and applies presentation policy. Callers separately enforce approved origins, TLS and dispatch, so these helpers cannot establish a connection.
src/gateway_core/http_auth/values.py Python A Expose exact replaceable authentication leaves and apply transient value-only overlays to a copied connection profile. missing_value_paths reports required empty inputs; apply_values limits names/scalars and reruns normal profile validation. No value is persisted and no arbitrary path traversal or authentication exchange occurs here.
src/gateway_core/http_cancellation.py Python A Bind HTTP execution IDs to cancellable socket owners and short-lived cancellation tombstones. cancel interrupts active owned I/O and remembers early cancellation; execute_owned rejects duplicate/remembered IDs, scopes sockets and releases them on every exit. State is process- local, and stopping I/O cannot roll back remote mutations.
src/gateway_core/http_client.py Python A Execute bounded Gateway target HTTP transactions using shared request validation, auth providers, session ownership and TLS options. The transaction loop bounds reads/redirects, permits at most one definitive session reauthentication for reads and records uncertainty after failed mutation transport. The wrapper keeps authentication/resource observations distinct and applies mandatory protection to private OAuth material; ordinary consumer redaction follows policy.
src/gateway_core/http_contract.py Python A Share deterministic request validation between Agent adapters and Gateway execution. Normalize methods, URLs, origins, headers, body carriers and bounds into PreparedHttpRequest; delegate profile validation, granted upload encoding and consumer redaction to their owners. No network request or saved-profile selection occurs here. Compatibility flags do not introduce credential prohibitions that the current literal-auth contract lacks.
src/gateway_core/http_download.py Python A Private bounded HTTP file staging; successful sources belong to TransferProvider.
src/gateway_core/http_errors.py Python A Translate target authentication statuses and transport exceptions into stable HTTP failure categories and catalog repair facts. These helpers omit raw exception/target text and distinguish authorization, credentials, configuration, TLS and Gateway runtime failures. Callers and behavior policy decide recovery effort; this module never retries traffic.
src/gateway_core/http_files.py Python A Convert private granted-context envelopes into bounded raw or multipart HTTP payloads. prepare_upload validates decoded bytes and metadata, enforces aggregate size and constructs transport bytes with urllib3. The controller grants context IDs and the Gateway requires their envelope; no arbitrary path lookup or persistent file store is implemented here.
src/gateway_core/http_logging.py Python A Install shared diagnostic filters for WebSocket and Uvicorn logs. PrivateHttpEnvelopeFilter always hides recognized binary transfer-frame dumps and applies optional LOGS redaction to ordinary text. Changes affect log records only, preserving original transport envelopes and their bytes.
src/gateway_core/http_profiles.py Python A Validate and project literal version-3 HTTP connection profiles for controller adapters and Gateway transport. Normalization owns schema, origin, TLS pairing and runtime-envelope checks without I/O; portable/model views separate exact transport data from policy-controlled consumer projections. Credential-binding helpers retain delivery identity while allowing session- extraction corrections. No implicit credential migration or network authentication occurs here.
src/gateway_core/http_runtime.py Python A Probe whether mandatory Gateway HTTP providers and dependencies can import, returning stable target-free readiness facts. The module uses the standard library and shared error catalog; http_readiness imports the implementation on demand. Its module entry point also checks Gateway server dependencies and exits according to readiness, without probing a target service.
src/gateway_core/http_sessions.py Python A Own bounded, volatile Requests sessions for Gateway HTTP transactions. SessionState holds cookies, derived values, secret provenance and a per-session lock; HttpSessionStore hashes scoped profile/origin identity, expires idle entries, serializes use and revokes scopes. Unscoped and overflow requests use disposable sessions. No cookie/token cache is written to disk.
src/gateway_core/http_tls.py Python A Prepare TLS and proxy settings for Gateway-executed HTTP requests from validated connection profiles. Inline CA/client material uses per-operation temporary PEM files; path-based material stays caller-owned. The context removes only its temporary files after transport, and tls_failure returns bounded catalog-owned error categories instead of raw exception text.
src/gateway_core/installation_check.py Python A Verify the full dependency profile in the selected virtual environment.
src/gateway_core/installation_smoke.py Python A Exercise installed document, OCR and plotting backends locally.
src/gateway_core/installation_state.py Python A Read optional verification failures for the current virtual environment.
src/gateway_core/instance.py Python A Select stable Gateway process-instance namespaces without changing legacy defaults.
src/gateway_core/ipc/init.py Python A One authenticated AF_INET JSON byte protocol for independent detached workers.
src/gateway_core/ipc/authority.py Python A Coordinate one Gateway hub with independently running job workers through authenticated local sessions. Durable dispatch fences and signed worker receipts remain separate from transport acceptance, preserving uncertainty across reconnects and crashes.
src/gateway_core/ipc/discovery.py Python A Publish and read protected Gateway owner discovery and job-specific worker tickets. src/gateway_core/ipc/protocol.py Python A Define the single bounded v1 JSON byte envelope for Gateway owner/worker communication. src/gateway_core/ipc/transport.py Python A Bound loopback worker connections, authentication and byte-frame I/O.
src/gateway_core/ipc/worker_client.py Python A Give a detached supervisor a single-job facade over authenticated reconnecting IPC. src/gateway_core/job_contract.py Python A Build shared public job receipts for confirmed rejection, uncertain launch and unavailable observation. Error-catalog strings are runtime contract inputs; these helpers do not query or mutate jobs.
src/gateway_core/job_logs.py Python A Store bounded job output in durable FIFO segments with absolute byte positions. src/gateway_core/job_progress.py Python A Publish bounded evidence of actual job output through a borrowed jobs owner or worker facade. src/gateway_core/jobs.py Python A Own Gateway foreground and detached job identities through the shared RAM state hub. src/gateway_core/kubernetes_context.py Python A Observe bounded Kubernetes routing and trust configuration around requested kubectl work. invocation recognizes supported command selectors; _ConfigLoader and _Snapshot read one safe kubeconfig and optional public CA; Observation compares before/after facts and emits setup/stale hashes. kubectl owns authentication, plugins, permissions and object data. src/gateway_core/lazy_app.py Python A Delay the default Gateway application factory until ASGI use or attribute inspection. Platform facades use this proxy so importing their app modules does not itself create the default service authority.
src/gateway_core/lifecycle.py Python A Shared lifecycle for standalone and server-embedded Gateway services.
src/gateway_core/local_ai/init.py Python A Typed Gateway-owned local inference runtimes; no inference calls.
src/gateway_core/local_ai/adapters.py Python A Translate five supported provider identities into bounded metadata reads and validated launch plans. src/gateway_core/local_ai/http.py Python A Bound provider metadata response reads by bytes and a monotonic deadline between chunks. src/gateway_core/local_ai/manager.py Python A Own selected-Gateway local AI process lifecycle and reconcile mutation identities across retries/restarts. src/gateway_core/local_ai/transport.py Python A Validate bounded Gateway Local AI receipts before the controller exposes them to tools. src/gateway_core/pairing.py Python A Manage the Gateway public controller pin, signed first-use challenge/response and explicit local reset. TLS identity survives pairing reset; initialized missing/corrupt state fails closed. Request acceptance returns controller/revision provenance for operation ownership.
src/gateway_core/paths.py Python A Resolve command working directories on the Gateway where execution will occur. resolve_gateway_execution_cwd combines explicit or configured CWD with the target filesystem, validates ordinary directories and defers mapped /tmp paths to the child namespace. src/gateway_core/pdf/availability.py Python A Probe optional PDF distributions and load requested backends lazily.
src/gateway_core/pdf/backend.py Python A Inspect and transform static PDFs inside the isolated parser worker.

src/gateway_core/pdf/contract.py Python A Define bounded PDF schemas and private authenticated wire envelopes.
src/gateway_core/pdf/service.py Python A Own PDF worker lifetime and atomic create-only publication on one Gateway.
src/gateway_core/pdf/worker.py Python A Execute one PDF request under process resource fuses and private staging.
src/gateway_core/pinned_tls.py Python A Capture and verify a configured peer public-key identity before operational HTTP/WebSocket bytes are sent. src/gateway_core/platform_process/windows_acl.py Python A Apply and inspect native Windows DACLs for private Gateway state. api/user obtain typed Win32 functions and current-user SID storage; protect installs an inheritable protected current-user/LocalSystem DACL, and check rejects unsafe paths or grants to other principals. src/gateway_core/platform_screen/macos.py Python A Use ScreenCaptureKit still images and Quartz metadata without Accessibility access.
src/gateway_core/platform_screen/protocol.py Python A Define call-local native screen access and lossless bounded raster encoding.
src/gateway_core/platform_screen/windows.py Python A Acquire a bounded GDI rectangle with per-monitor DPI-aware Win32 geometry.
src/gateway_core/platforms.py Python A Normalize platform names used by detection, configuration and remote registration. normalize_platform maps recognized aliases to the shared three-platform vocabulary and preserves unknown values as unknown; platform_label supplies display text. src/gateway_core/privilege.py Python A Implement local POSIX elevation using the ordinary executor and one completion classifier for buffered and streamed callers. stream_privileged_execution validates exact metadata bindings, isolates sudo authentication stdin, recognizes a fresh elevation marker and filters private protocol material. execute_privileged only collects that stream. src/gateway_core/privilege_target.py Python A Classify privilege destinations without consulting conversation history.
src/gateway_core/process_outcome.py Python A Validate process receipt facts without interpreting command-specific exit codes.
src/gateway_core/process_telemetry.py Python A Collect optional diagnostics for a Gateway command whose recorded process identity still matches. sample returns CPU, root memory/IO, child count and observation time, with bounded live-child CPU sampling and conservative omission on inaccessible evidence. src/gateway_core/purge_browser.py Python A Select browser-owned execution history and caches for Gateway runtime purge. paths selects complete disposable session-profile trees separately from reusable account profiles, whose ownership marker is required and whose cookies/preferences remain setup. src/gateway_core/purge_inventory.py Python A Define the closed ownership classification used by Gateway purge. src/gateway_core/removable_destinations.py Python A Observe eligible mounted removable destinations on the execution host.
src/gateway_core/reset.py Python A Recover local Gateway controller enrollment and cached peer connection state without clearing execution history. cleanup_paths validates a bounded plan, reset_gateway acquires exclusive lifecycle/identity ownership and replaces pairing, and main exposes instance-aware preview/reset commands. src/gateway_core/resource_claims.py Python A Derive independent process ownership, historical effects and classification revisions.
src/gateway_core/resource_descriptors.py Python A Describe concrete Gateway resource claims using shared shell operand rules.
src/gateway_core/resource_execution.py Python A Coordinate foreground execution through the durable Gateway job authority.
src/gateway_core/resource_locking.py Python A Persist Controller-scoped resource policy and coordinate Gateway admission.
src/gateway_core/resource_observations.py Python A Provide narrow filesystem evidence for historical command reconciliation after physical claims are released. paths recognizes explicit operands of a small command subset; reconciles checks fresh run-correlated read coverage, and inspect_effects observes current metadata/absence without executing anything. src/gateway_core/resource_reset.py Python A Explicit, correlated job reset with durable intent and verified process termination.
src/gateway_core/restart_cleanup.py Python A Drain this Gateway's owned executions before a restart can acknowledge success.
src/gateway_core/runtime_policy.py Python A Carry authenticated controller policy separately from Gateway business arguments. src/gateway_core/runtime_purge.py Python A Coordinate owner-requested Gateway runtime cleanup through durable operations, storage ownership and request epochs. preview and manage expose authenticated maintenance; recover/_apply resume offline replacement of disposable history while preserving policy, replay protection and installation setup. admit fences requests against purge/update state, and drain closes live writers before restart. src/gateway_core/runtime_readiness.py Python A Validate the local installed Gateway runtime before supported startup without installation or network repair. validate_runtime caches dependency/process-identity checks and source/build revision facts; validate_snapshot rejects editable or overlaid installations, and main also requires HTTP support. src/gateway_core/runtime_state/init.py Python A Expose the Gateway RAM authority and its process-local lookup/shutdown entry points. GatewayJobs and transport owners share get_hub for one state root; persistence implementation remains in recovery rather than being a runtime query API.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/main.py Python A Expose offline Gateway state inspection, complete safety-bundle backup/restore and explicit previous-generation repair. Commands validate identities, private files and independent safety evidence under owner leases; backup/repair additionally require workers to be drained. New destination paths preserve existing installations, and failures propagate without silently selecting older state.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/audit.py Python A Provide opt-in process-level evidence that Gateway SQL access occurs only during bootstrap, checkpoint or repair. install registers owned roots and one CPython audit hook, catching saved connect aliases as well as ordinary calls. src/gateway_core/runtime_state/authorization.py Python A Carry authenticated Gateway request provenance in a ContextVar across asynchronous routes and worker-thread calls. Authentication middleware sets request_authorization; dispatch and filesystem actions consume it to bind accepted work to the controller. The default is no authenticated request, and this module performs no authentication itself.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/fences.py Python A Keep the minimum durable Gateway safety evidence independent of asynchronous checkpoints. SafetyFences reserves dispatches and nonces, validates foreground/worker completion receipts and restores uncertain claims after restart. It collaborates with the RAM hub, private-file primitives, job reconciliation and IPC tickets; invalid evidence blocks recovery instead of inventing successful completion.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/files.py Python A Implement private filesystem records and lifetime owner leases for Gateway state. Validation and bounded descriptor reads protect record identity; atomic publishes flushed JSON used by checkpoints, fences and receipts. Root/node leases prevent overlapping owners, including copied identities and fork inheritance. Errors propagate to the owner so unsafe or uncertain persistence cannot authorize work.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/hub.py Python A Own all live Gateway state for one root through immutable RAM records and optimistic transactions. Transaction performs atomic publication, accounting, admission indexes and event sequencing; GatewayRuntimeStateHub bootstraps recovery/fences, owns process leases and coordinates checkpoints and worker IPC. Registry helpers share one owner and prevent overlap across shutdown or fork. Physical effects remain outside state retries and publication locks.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/indexes.py Python A Derive conservative active-resource and uncertain-GPU candidate indexes from Gateway job facts. Transaction publication maintains these indexes so admission and reconciliation avoid scanning closed history. Shared execution resource overlap/classifier rules determine memberships; these helpers identify candidates and do not independently authorize effects.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/limits.py Python A Read explicit RAM admission budgets for GatewayRuntimeStateHub. Limits covers job counts, active jobs and serialized record/total bytes; malformed or undersized settings fail startup. Capacity policy rejects growth and never substitutes SQL queries or evicts uncertain execution evidence.
src/gateway_core/runtime_state/recovery.py Python A Own Gateway state SQLite exclusively for legacy bootstrap imports and complete checkpoint generations. Guarded connections/cursors forbid ordinary runtime SQL; restore validates a selected committed generation, while Checkpointer serializes immutable hub snapshots and atomically publishes their manifests. Corruption requires explicit repair, and checkpoint failure remains visible while RAM stays authoritative.
src/gateway_core/screen_contract.py Python A Validate explicit screen observations and bounded geometry at both wire boundaries.
src/gateway_core/screen_service.py Python A Execute explicit screen observations with call-owned cancellation and run artifacts.
src/gateway_core/screen_worker.py Python A Isolate native screen IPC and bound subprocess output, cancellation and lifetime.
src/gateway_core/serve.py Python A Launch a platform Gateway ASGI target over HTTPS. main selects instance and bind defaults before loading managed effective settings, prepares the retained TLS identity and starts Uvicorn with lifespan enabled. It reports invalid instance arguments through argparse and exposes effective startup information; this entry point owns the listener, while application lifespan and service owners manage runtime state.
src/gateway_core/service.py Python A Compose the target-host operation graph shared by inbound HTTP and outbound WebSocket dispatch. GatewayService owns effective settings, jobs/worker IPC, provider instances, configuration/update control and legacy/typed model-runtime coordination. Operation methods validate target ownership, scope artifact use, preserve process/dispatch evidence and delegate physical effects to providers. Foreground helpers apply timeout policy and accepted setup observations; restart refuses owned model processes. Provider readiness, stored configuration and process completion remain distinct facts.
src/gateway_core/shared_shell.py Python A Gateway-owned interactive Bash with command boundaries on a private control pipe.
src/gateway_core/slurm_context.py Python A Observe local SLURM configuration identity around supported Linux scheduler CLI work. invocation and _environment bound target selection, _Snapshot reads a limited include tree, and Observation publishes unchanged local routing after truthful success. Queue/job data, authentication files and scheduler connections stay with the requested CLI. Expected unsupported configuration declines continuity; structural runtime defects retain an explicit fault before dispatch or alongside the actual post-dispatch outcome.
src/gateway_core/ssh_context.py Python A Extract verified public SSH setup from one captured OpenSSH attempt. observe builds strict options and temporary logs/pins; Observation.finish classifies private handshake evidence and publishes endpoint/account/key facts after supported authentication. Initial enrollment uses existing OpenSSH trust and a bounded post-command configuration check; reuse retains host pins without a session store. Unsupported evidence cannot establish setup, and recognized transport failures use canonical error output.
src/gateway_core/ssh_privilege.py Python A Execute one elevated command inside an already verified SSH destination. _plan binds exact account/host/key identity, _check_config revalidates the route, and _stream carries a password only on stdin while separating process spawn from remote elevated-start/completion markers. Buffered and streaming facades share resource admission, redaction and bounded output. Lost completion preserves possible remote effects without replay or Gateway-local sudo. Shared RAM/recovery owners provide admission persistence; no local synchronous checkpoint barrier is implied by the original header.
src/gateway_core/startup_info.py Python A Render Gateway registration guidance from effective settings and an optional TLS certificate. print_gateway_info distinguishes an inbound HTTPS listener from an outbound Server connection, includes the logical node and public-key fingerprint, and delegates address formatting/output to smto_runtime.connection_info. These are local setup hints; they neither test reachability nor perform pairing.
src/gateway_core/state_lifecycle.py Python A Coordinate a running Gateway with local recovery/reset operations through a retained lock file in the private identity directory. state_lease grants shared runtime access or exclusive reset access using nonblocking platform locks, rejects symbolic-link lock paths and releases ownership on context exit. This reset-exclusion lease is distinct from the jobs authority lease and does not itself establish process readiness.
src/gateway_core/terminal.py Python A Select and re-export the persistent interactive-terminal backend for the host OS. POSIX supplies real session/capture lifecycle helpers; Windows exposes compatible interfaces that explicitly reject unsupported persistent sessions. Optional TerminalUnsupportedError is exported only when supplied by the backend. Managed command-owned TTY jobs use tty_process and its separate POSIX/ConPTY adapters.
src/gateway_core/terminal_handoff.py Python A Prompt-scoped input handoff. Deadlines and typing ownership live at the Gateway.
src/gateway_core/terminal_input_guard.py Python A Cross-process ownership fence for command-owned worker PTYs.
src/gateway_core/terminal_owned.py Python A Launch or cancel one captured POSIX terminal command group without deliberately terminating its persistent parent shell. launch and cancel serialize through a locked JSON control file, publishing a PID or cancellation tombstone before exec/signals. The terminal capture owner creates and retires this temporary evidence. These local process-group signals are separate from durable Gateway job admission and completion receipts.
src/gateway_core/terminal_posix.py Python A Own process-local persistent interactive shell sessions for Linux/macOS Gateways. TerminalSession manages PTY IO, CWD markers, bounded display/capture events and one captured command at a time. Capture wrappers and terminal_owned separate command cancellation from the parent shell; registry helpers create, find, expire and close sessions. Input hints are heuristics, session events are not durable job receipts, and iterator cleanup alone does not prove process termination.
src/gateway_core/terminal_protocol.py Python A Allow terminal-generated replies only after a matching PTY query.
src/gateway_core/terminal_windows.py Python A Preserve terminal interfaces while explicitly rejecting unsupported Windows interactive
src/gateway_core/tls_identity.py Python A Create and renew the Gateway self-signed TLS certificate while preserving its durable RSA identity key. src/gateway_core/tmp_mapping.py Python A Route negotiated Linux run /tmp access into managed temporary storage while retaining a safe pre-execution TMPDIR fallback. workspace_mode probes and persists downgrade state; launch_argv builds a supervisor that preserves user identity and records readiness before a command can run. Launch and TerminalLaunch own receipt lifetime for executors and terminal providers. A command failure or signal cannot authorize replay; this mount layout is not a general host filesystem sandbox.

src/gateway_core/transfer_contract.py Python A Bound the private controller-mediated file transfer protocol.
src/gateway_core/transfer_journal.py Python A Retain node-scoped transfer stage ownership and commit intent in the shared Gateway RAM owner. Terminal fence failures preserve current RAM truth with degraded persistence; unfenced commit intent is refused. Providers serialize physical copying, while this module owns recovery metadata rather than file contents or transfer transport.
src/gateway_core/transfer_paths.py Python A Pin target-native transfer parents without symlink or reparse traversal.
src/gateway_core/transfer_wire.py Python A Frame bounded file chunks with their request metadata in one binary message.
src/gateway_core/transport_security.py Python A Evaluate transport verification facts shared by Controller Gateway consumers. loopback recognizes local literal addresses without DNS resolution; authenticated_transport requires verified HTTPS or the legacy HTTP loopback predicate for direct connections, and WSS plus both peer/controller verification facts for outbound sessions. Callers own actual handshakes, stronger readiness checks and operation permission; this helper neither opens sockets nor grants execution authority.
src/gateway_core/tty_posix.py Python A Provide a command-owned POSIX controlling terminal for managed TTY jobs. TtyProcess allocates PTY/notification descriptors and starts a fresh helper; main establishes session/terminal ownership before replacing itself with the requested command. Read/write and lifecycle methods feed the shared tty_process stream owner, which classifies outcomes and retains job observations. No persistent interactive shell registry lives here.
src/gateway_core/tty_process.py Python A Stream one managed TTY job and deliver ordinary input without accidental duplicate writes. prepare_input validates Enter/raw semantics, InputWriter retains identified delivery receipts, and stream_command owns a PTY/ConPTY plus reader/cancellation callbacks. Combined output uses bounded backpressure and incremental UTF-8 decoding; readiness and final process state remain separate. IPC/jobs callers authorize run scope and retain receipts; this module owns physical IO and cleanup.
src/gateway_core/tty_windows.py Python A Adapt native Windows ConPTY to the shared command-owned TTY process interface. supported and bindings discover/decorate the Win32 ABI; TtyProcess creates pipes/console, assigns a suspended child to a kill-on-close Job Object and resumes only after ownership is established. Async console closure lets output drain while process exit is observed. IO/native failures propagate to the stream owner; these jobs are separate from unsupported Windows persistent terminal sessions.

src/smto_runtime/init.py Python A Identify source, legacy-image and compiled distributions without an environment-variable bypass.
