src/smto_runtime/accounts.py Python A Installation accounts, sessions and administrative authority, available before hive restore.
src/smto_runtime/accounts_web.py Python A Small account administration surface independent of user hive readiness.
src/smto_runtime/build_version.py Python A Commit-based binary identity, captured by builders and read unchanged at runtime.
src/smto_runtime/connection_info.py Python A Explain how a user can reach a newly launched listener. listener_hosts enumerates local interfaces for wildcard binds; listener_lines/url format IPv4/IPv6 addresses and scope guidance; print_server_info prints the Agent UI address. It performs no remote reachability probes, and closed diagnostic output must not prevent service launch.
src/smto_runtime/entrypoint.py Python A Translate packaged Server/Gateway CLI options into their existing startup owners. main selects the build role, server_environment expands retained startup defaults, serve_server configures owner login and starts the web bundle, and serve_gateway chooses inbound or outbound transport after readiness checks. Collaborates with distribution context, portal_auth, server_tls and gateway_core; failures propagate to the launcher without installing software.
src/smto_runtime/features.py Python A Build-owned feature identity. Packaged metadata always overrides source defaults.
src/smto_runtime/gateway_access.py Python A Reuse validated account facts on a stream without delaying access revocation.
src/smto_runtime/gateway_update.py Python A Define the detached Gateway package contract and private durable update journal. descriptor/package_url/compatible validate metadata and supported identities; Journal serializes current operation changes and archives displaced receipts before replacement. Filesystem helpers reject linked/unsafe metadata and publish atomic JSON. Controller release discovery, the live Gateway update owner and the independent installer helper share these rules; reading a descriptor or journal does not authorize installation.
src/smto_runtime/gateway_update_helper.py Python A Own download, candidate preparation, Gateway activation and rollback independently of the controller connection. download/executable verify accepted package facts; Installer calls the compiled lifecycle registry/services and waits for drain/readiness receipts; run resumes or recovers journal phases under an exclusive helper lease. Preparation and activation failures remain distinct, and failed rollback is recorded explicitly. No model inference participates in this installer state machine.
src/smto_runtime/gateway_update_process.py Python A Move Server/Gateway update ownership outside the process being replaced. spawn builds a compiled helper command, selects a transient OS service/task or detached process and waits for a verified acknowledgement. detach starts the recorded replacement with its own saved environment; cleanup removes helper registration only after journal work. This module performs process/service side effects and is called only after update acceptance, not by status reads.
src/smto_runtime/https_redirect.py Python A Redirect plaintext HTTP on an active HTTPS listener without opening another port.
src/smto_runtime/installation_legal.py Python A Obtain local installer assent for the exact selected legal documents without changing product consent. documents/validate_flags/show expose verified terms and explicit acceptance options; confirm prompts on a terminal or checks both version flags, then writes a private invocation receipt. data_root selects platform installation storage and verify_acceptance validates internal nested handoff. Public installer invocations must obtain their own acceptance.
src/smto_runtime/lifecycle_pages.py Python A Share startup/shutdown presentation between the outer Server shell and embedded runtimes. assets/asset expose only fixed packaged resources, while page escapes lifecycle text into the common HTML template and inserts its trusted bundled mark. Inputs are detached lifecycle snapshots; rendering does not access controller state, change persistence or authorize a restart.
src/smto_runtime/log_limits.py Python A Share exact execution-log capacity validation between controller and Gateway. byte_capacity canonicalizes positive decimal strings without floating-point conversion; ByteCapacity applies it to schemas and execution_log_limit reads an engine live provider or configured fallback. Returning strings preserves capacities larger than JavaScript numeric precision; this module does not allocate storage or enforce file retention itself.
src/smto_runtime/portal_auth.py Python A Own installation-local portal credentials and sessions before controller restoration. AuthStore validates private storage, locks atomic updates, hashes passwords, limits attempts and creates/revokes bounded sessions. Credential prompts and setup/reset CLI helpers operate locally; portal_web and portal_client consume these contracts. This private .auth state is separate from controller databases, provider OAuth credentials and legal acceptance.
src/smto_runtime/portal_client.py Python A Authenticate a single administrative CLI invocation through the same portal boundary as the browser. PortalClient obtains local credentials, creates an in-memory cookie jar, sends bounded JSON requests with origin/CSRF headers and attempts logout on context exit. TLS uses system verification and proxy discovery is disabled; credentials and cookies are not persisted for later invocations.
src/smto_runtime/portal_web.py Python A Apply the installation owner-login boundary consistently to Server, startup shell and Console ASGI apps. PortalAuthMiddleware handles login/session/password routes, same-origin/CSRF checks and streaming-session revocation; install adapts interactive API docs. Fixed auth assets and minimal health responses are public. Explicit Gateway, callback and artifact paths retain their own authentication owners, while accepted portal sessions attach owner scope to inner requests.
src/smto_runtime/principal.py Python A Trusted account/workspace context shared by HTTP requests and owned background work.
src/smto_runtime/purge_processes.py Python A Stop previously owned process trees before runtime purge can remove their state. owned_command recovers matching command/group members; stop rechecks creation identity, requests graceful termination, escalates after its deadline and requires confirmed exit. gateway_core platform identity helpers supply verification. Uncertain or inaccessible ownership blocks purge rather than signaling an unverified process or claiming it stopped.
src/smto_runtime/runtime_purge.py Python A Provide shared conservative filesystem and journal primitives for explicitly inventoried runtime cleanup. safe/walk reject links, hardlinks and unapproved mount crossings before removal. write/read persist operation identities and progress separately from retained setup. Journal resumes unfinished epochs and publishes target completion atomically. Controller/Gateway purge owners choose targets, preserve setup and stop work; these helpers do not independently authorize or expand the deletion scope.
src/smto_runtime/serve.py Python A Wrap Uvicorn launch with readable startup failures and authoritative Server bind settings. main dispatches its CLI, StartupDiagnosticFilter explains early listener errors, and terminal_error formats catalog guidance. Active TLS listeners redirect plaintext HTTP on the same port. The web-bundle supervisor recognizes the dedicated SSL-context failure exit code to retry its owned listeners over HTTP; other failures return a normal nonzero exit.
src/smto_runtime/server.py Python A Keep login, lifecycle pages and diagnostics responsive while one Controller restores or saves its state. StartupServer owns the inner app lifespan in a bootstrap task and gates HTTP/WebSocket dispatch until readiness. StartupStatus and startup_report expose RAM observations; portal_web supplies owner authentication, lifecycle_pages renders progress, and server_update_web handles early update operations. Cooperative shutdown waits for durable finalization before releasing the bootstrap owner.
src/smto_runtime/server_resources.py Python A Persist installation-wide server limits and apply only the process soft limit.
src/smto_runtime/server_tls.py Python A Own installation web TLS as immutable certificate generations and a revisioned selection manifest. CertificateStore validates generated/uploaded pairs, preserves prior material on failure and publishes explicit HTTPS or HTTP fallback facts for web_bundle. generate_pair/inspect_pair handle certificate identity; private path and atomic-write helpers share portal_auth protections. Keys remain outside controller settings and public responses; selecting material is separate from restarting listeners.
src/smto_runtime/server_update.py Python A Specialize update contracts for one registered compiled Server instance. descriptor/compatible retain target and feature variant, installed verifies the running registry identity and managed environment, and Journal/public expose a distinct Server operation namespace. trusted_probe authorizes minimal readiness identity using the active operation secret. Source/legacy installations and ambiguous registry matches remain unsupported instead of selecting a sibling installation.
src/smto_runtime/server_update_helper.py Python A Replace a compiled Server only after its own durable final-save receipt. Installer reuses package preparation and registry mechanics while requiring matching Server boot, variant, process and web-bundle readiness proofs. run waits without a kill deadline while authoritative RAM drains, recovers interrupted activation through rollback and retains failed outcomes in the private journal. The helper survives the original Server process and never treats an old ready instance as the replacement.
src/smto_runtime/server_update_web.py Python A Keep owner-only update status and eligible retry/cancel actions available through startup/shutdown. handle uses the live update service when present or reads the registered installation journal before readiness; unsupported early mutations return unavailable. runtime_request delegates the untouched ASGI receive stream for ordinary update routes. Portal middleware owns session/CSRF validation, and the update services own installation authorization.
src/smto_runtime/setup_connection.py Python A Read effective packaged listener settings and existing public identity without starting it.
src/smto_runtime/shutdown_report.py Python A Describe durable shutdown as observed by the lifecycle owner. ShutdownReport extends StartupReport with ordered stop/save/release phases, row-count progress and the first confirmed durable-save notification. Deferred obsolete-file cleanup remains separate from save success. Callers perform all stop, persistence and restart work; snapshot readers consume in-memory copies without probing the database.
src/smto_runtime/startup.py Python A Measure startup work without owning the work itself. observe_startup scopes optional observers and stop requests; startup_phase reports nested phases and joins its heartbeat thread; startup_rows/startup_work count existing iteration rather than rereading state. PhaseProgress publishes throttled counters to startup_report. Only static labels and work counts belong here; observer/output failures must not interrupt bootstrap ownership.
src/smto_runtime/startup_fixes.py Python A Explain and, where it is safe, repair startup failures for the signed-in admin.
src/smto_runtime/startup_report.py Python A Maintain bounded startup/shutdown observations independent of controller storage. StartupReport validates producer counters, derives throughput/history estimates and returns RAM-only snapshots. configure_history/save are explicit private-file operations owned by lifecycle callers; snapshot never reads files or SQL. startup.py supplies phase events and server.py samples RSS outside HTTP status reads.
